title: Centralized AI Asset Tracking Platform
description:
I want to streamline how my AI engineering team handles data sets, prompts, model versions, and any change that touches them. Right now these assets live in scattered notebooks, cloud buckets, and ad-hoc spreadsheets, which makes collaboration and auditing painful. 

The job is to design and set up a single, intuitive workspace where every model, prompt, data sample, and code change can be logged, related, and searched. Whether you build on an existing MLOps solution (like MLflow, Weights & Biases, or a comparable open-source stack) or propose a lightweight custom dashboard, the end result should let any engineer on my team: 
• Push a model or prompt and automatically capture its metadata, version, and lineage 
• View a consolidated history of changes and roll back when needed 
• Tag and filter assets by project, owner, or release 
• Export or query the full audit trail for compliance reviews 

I’m open to the specific tooling as long as it supports our Python-based workflow and can be integrated with Git and our CI/CD pipeline. A short discovery call to map the existing process, followed by staged milestones (design, prototype, production roll-out) will keep us aligned. 

If you have hands-on experience setting up asset management or MLOps tracking in live environments, I’d love to see a concise example or demo link when you reply.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчику нужно единое рабочее пространство для учёта моделей, промптов, датасетов и изменений кода с версионированием, связями, поиском, откатом и выгрузкой аудит-трейла, с интеграцией в Git и CI/CD. Бюджет 25 USD явно не соответствует объёму работ.
analysis.reply:
You want one place where models, prompts, datasets and code changes are logged, linked and searchable, with a clear audit trail and rollback. I'd start small: use MLflow or a similar open-source tracking server for runs and model versions, then add a thin Python SDK that captures metadata and lineage automatically, plus a Git/CI hook that records commits and releases. Tags for project, owner and release would live in the same store, with a simple search view and an export endpoint for audits. I'd deliver it in stages: a short discovery call, a working prototype of the push-and-search flow, then rollout to your team. Which tracking tools does your team use today, and which part of the audit trail matters most for compliance? Live demos are at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы хотите одно место, где модели, промпты, датасеты и изменения кода логируются, связываются и ищутся, с понятным аудит-трейлом и откатом. Я бы начал с малого: использовал MLflow или похожий open-source трекинг-сервер для запусков и версий моделей, затем добавил бы тонкий Python SDK, который автоматически собирает метаданные и lineage, и хук Git/CI для записи коммитов и релизов. Теги по проекту, владельцу и релизу хранились бы в том же хранилище, с простым поиском и эндпоинтом для выгрузки аудита. Работу я бы вёл поэтапно: короткий discovery-звонок, рабочий прототип потока push-and-search, затем внедрение в команде. Какими трекинг-инструментами команда пользуется сейчас и какая часть аудит-трейла важнее всего для комплаенса? Живые демо: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Escrow-Style Freelancer Payment System
description:
I regularly contract writers, marketers, and virtual assistants and I want every payment to stay on hold until I have reviewed and accepted their work. Your task is to build (or configure) a simple, reliable mechanism that lets me fund a job upfront while keeping the money locked in escrow until I press “approve”.

Core needs 
• Securely collect funds, store them, and release only after my sign-off. 
• Intuitive interface where I can request revisions or finalise payment in one click. 
• Clear status updates so freelancers always know whether their draft, campaign, or admin task has been accepted. 
• Time-stamped activity log for basic audit purposes. 

Deliverables 
1. Working payment-hold solution (custom code, plug-in, or no-code workflow—your choice, as long as it is reliable and easy to maintain). 
2. Short setup manual my team can follow. 
3. A template agreement that explains the “approve-then-pay” rule to freelancers. 

Acceptance criteria 
• Payment cannot be released without my explicit action. 
• System supports typical writing, marketing, and admin job sizes (USD and GBP gateways preferable). 
• All instructions and credentials are handed over on completion. 

When you reply, outline the tools or services you would leverage (e.g., Stripe Connect, PayPal Adaptive, Escrow.com API, Airtable + Zapier, etc.), estimated implementation time, and any ongoing costs I should expect.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет систему, которая удерживает оплату фрилансерам до его подтверждения работы: с запросами на правки, статусами для исполнителей, журналом действий, инструкцией по настройке и шаблоном договора. Бюджет 50 USD, объём работ больше бюджета.
analysis.reply:
You want freelancer payments held until you approve each deliverable, with one-click revision requests, clear status updates for the freelancer, and a timestamped activity log. I would build the approval flow as an automated pipeline: a job record, approve and revise actions, automatic status notifications, and an audit trail that logs every change. Using a modern stack with AI-assisted development, I can deliver a working version in about 3 to 4 days, then hand over the setup manual, the agreement template, and all credentials. Since the marketplace handles payments, I would keep the release step as a gated action in the workflow rather than building any payment logic.

Two questions: Should the tool connect to the marketplace through its API, or work as a standalone approval system? Do you have a preferred place to manage jobs, such as a spreadsheet or a web dashboard?

You can see live demos here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы хотите, чтобы оплата фрилансерам удерживалась до вашего подтверждения каждой работы, с запросами на правки в один клик, понятными статусами для исполнителя и журналом действий с временными метками. Я бы построил процесс согласования как автоматизированный пайплайн: карточка задачи, действия «подтвердить» и «отправить на правки», автоматические уведомления о статусе и журнал аудита, где фиксируется каждое изменение. Используя современный стек и разработку с ИИ-ассистентами, я могу сделать рабочую версию примерно за 3–4 дня, а затем передать инструкцию по настройке, шаблон договора и все доступы. title: Admin WhatsApp Responsif
description:
Saya membutuhkan seorang admin yang bisa mengambil alih balasan WhatsApp pelanggan setiap hari. Fokus utama Anda adalah:

• Menjawab pertanyaan seputar harga, promo, stok, ketersediaan, cara pemesanan, dan pengiriman secara cepat, ramah, dan akurat. 
• Menggunakan template jawaban dan panduan produk yang akan saya sediakan, lalu menyesuaikannya dengan nada bicara brand. 
• Menyaring pertanyaan kompleks atau keluhan yang membutuhkan eskalasi, kemudian mencatatnya di Google Sheets agar tim inti bisa menindaklanjuti. 

Kriteria yang saya cari: 
• Terbiasa memakai WhatsApp Business (label, quick reply, katalog). 
• Fast-response—idealnya membalas dalam ≤5 menit pada jam kerja yang kita sepakati. 
• Bahasa Indonesia tertulis yang rapi dan mudah dipahami. 

Output harian yang saya harapkan: 
1. Log chat singkat (file .xls atau Google Sheets) berisi pertanyaan, solusi yang diberikan, dan status selesai/escalate. 
2. Rekap FAQ baru jika muncul pertanyaan di luar daftar yang ada. 

Pekerjaan ini bersifat berkelanjutan; saya akan mulai dengan masa uji coba satu minggu. Jika performa memuaskan, kerja sama dapat diperpanjang.

title: AI FAQ Telegram Chatbot
description:
I need a Telegram bot that automatically answers our users’ frequently asked questions. I’ll supply a clean document / FAQ list that should serve as the sole knowledge base, so the bot must parse that content and draw every reply from it with a helpful, conversational tone.

Core flow 
• A user asks a question in Telegram. 
• The bot checks the supplied FAQ data, selects the most relevant answer and responds immediately. 
• If no match is detected, I want the bot to give a polite fallback response that I can later edit in the code or an admin panel.

Technical notes 
Python, Node, or any stack that plays nicely with the Telegram Bot API and an NLP layer such as OpenAI, LangChain, Rasa, or similar is fine—feel free to suggest what you are most comfortable with. What matters is that I can: 
• update or replace the FAQ file myself without touching code, 
• view basic logs/analytics that show unanswered questions so we can expand the document over time, 
• host the bot on a modest cloud instance (Heroku / Render / AWS Lightsail are all acceptable).

Deliverables 
1. Source code with clear setup instructions. 
2. Deployed bot running in a test Telegram group for live validation. 
3. Short README or screencast walking me through adding new FAQs and redeploying.

Once everything works smoothly in the test group, I’ll add the bot to our public channel. Let me know the timeline you need to turn this around and any libraries you prefer so we can get started.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен Telegram-бот, который отвечает на частые вопросы пользователей только по загруженному клиентом FAQ-документу, с дружелюбным тоном и редактируемым запасным ответом. Также нужны логи неотвеченных вопросов, инструкция по обновлению FAQ и деплой на недорогом облачном хостинге.
analysis.reply:
You need a Telegram bot that answers users' common questions using only your FAQ document, with a friendly tone and an editable fallback when nothing matches. I'd build it in Python with python-telegram-bot, load the FAQ from a plain CSV or Markdown file, and match questions with embeddings (OpenAI or a local sentence-transformers model), so paraphrased questions still find the right answer. Unmatched questions would be logged to SQLite and viewable through a simple admin command. I'd deploy to Render or Lightsail and include a README on adding FAQs and redeploying. Estimated timeline: 5–7 days to a working test-group version, plus a day for handoff. Two questions: what format is your FAQ document in now, and roughly how many entries do you expect? Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен Telegram-бот, который отвечает на частые вопросы пользователей, используя только ваш FAQ-документ, с дружелюбным тоном и редактируемым запасным ответом, если совпадения нет. Я бы сделал его на Python с python-telegram-bot, загружал FAQ из простого CSV или Markdown-файла и подбирал ответы с помощью эмбеддингов (OpenAI или локальной модели sentence-transformers), чтобы перефразированные вопросы тоже находили нужный ответ. Я бы задеплоил бот на Render или Lightsail и приложил README с инструкцией по добавлению FAQ и повторному деплою. Ориентировочный срок: 5–7 дней до рабочей версии в тестовой группе, плюс день на передачу. Два вопроса: в каком формате сейчас FAQ-документ и примерно сколько записей вы ожидаете? title: Ventas Gabriel -- 2
description:

Solo ofreceré servicios o reservas, así que no necesito gestión de inventario físico ni cálculo de envíos; lo importante es un proceso de checkout claro, seguro y en español.

Necesito que el diseño sea responsive y fácil de administrar: preferiría trabajar sobre WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify o la plataforma que recomiendes siempre que me permita actualizar textos, precios y horarios sin tocar código. Integra un pasarela de pago (Stripe, PayPal o similar), configura los correos de confirmación y asegúrate de que el panel muestre las órdenes en tiempo real.

Entrego los textos y las imágenes; tú te encargas de instalar la plantilla, personalizarla con mi marca y dejar todo funcionando en mi hosting. Cuando esté listo necesito una breve sesión de capacitación o video guía para que pueda manejar reservas, reembolsos y reportes sin complicaciones.

Acepto propuestas que incluyan:
• URL de ejemplos de sitios de reservas que hayas construido.
• Tiempo estimado de desarrollo.
• Herramientas/plataforma que usarás y por qué.

El objetivo es lanzar rápido, pero no sacrificar seguridad ni usabilidad. Espero tu propuesta.

Propongo WordPress + WooCommerce: los servicios se cargan como productos con precio y horario editables sin código, el checkout se traduce al español y las órdenes y los correos de confirmación se configuran desde el panel. title: Aumentar Ventas por WhatsApp
description:
Quiero organizar y potenciar todo mi proceso de ventas, con el objetivo inmediato de conseguir más clientes. Para lograrlo nos enfocaremos casi exclusivamente en WhatsApp y mensajes directos, el canal donde hoy recibo la mayoría de las consultas.

Necesito que revises de principio a fin mi embudo actual, detectes los cuellos de botella y diseñes un sistema claro que me permita:

• Captar prospectos a través de campañas o estrategias que lleven la conversación a WhatsApp 
• Guiar cada interacción con guiones y respuestas rápidas que aumenten la tasa de cierre 
• Registrar y seguir cada lead en un tablero o CRM sencillo, para no perder oportunidades 
• Medir resultados con indicadores simples (contactos diarios, citas agendadas, ventas cerradas) y proponer ajustes continuos

Trabajo con un producto físico de venta directa, por lo que la inmediatez de la respuesta es clave. Aprecio soluciones prácticas: plantillas de mensajes, automatizaciones ligeras (por ejemplo, WhatsApp Business API o chatbots básicos) y reportes que pueda entender de un vistazo.

Entrego acceso a mis números de contacto, historial de chats recientes y cualquier dato que necesites para mapear el proceso. El entregable final deberá incluir:

1. Documento de estrategia paso a paso 
2. Flujos de mensajes listos para copiar-pegar o cargar en un bot 
3. Estructura de seguimiento (hoja de cálculo o CRM recomendado) 
4. Métricas iniciales y meta sugerida para los primeros 30 días

Todo debe quedar implementado o listo para usar; la idea es que al terminar pueda comenzar a atraer y convertir más clientes sin demoras.

title: Integrasi Gmail WhatsApp Instagram
description:
Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk menyiapkan satu akun Gmail bisnis yang benar-benar siap dipakai untuk menerima pesanan dan pertanyaan pelanggan. Fokus utama saya adalah membuat alur masuk pesan dari WhatsApp Business dan Instagram langsung ke kotak masuk Gmail agar semuanya terkumpul rapi, mudah ditindaklanjuti, dan dapat saya jawab secepat mungkin.

Ruang lingkup yang saya harapkan:
• Membuat atau mengonfigurasi akun Google Workspace/Gmail bisnis agar tampak profesional (alamat domain saya sendiri, signature, filter, label, dan keamanan dasar). 
• Menautkan WhatsApp Business ke Gmail—misalnya melalui notifikasi email, integrasi API, atau automation pihak ketiga—sehingga setiap chat baru, pesanan, atau pertanyaan otomatis tercatat di Gmail. 
• Menyambungkan Direct Message Instagram ke Gmail dengan pendekatan serupa sehingga semua DM penting masuk sebagai email yang bisa saya arsipkan atau delegasikan. 
• Menyiapkan aturan pengelompokan (label atau folder) agar pesan dari kedua platform tersebut terpisah dari email internal lain, namun tetap mudah dicari. 
• Mendokumentasikan langkah konfigurasi serta memberikan panduan ringkas cara memelihara integrasi bila terjadi perubahan login, token, atau setting.

Hasil akhir yang saya inginkan adalah:
1. Akun Gmail bisnis aktif dan tervalidasi. 
2. Pesan pelanggan dari WhatsApp Business dan Instagram otomatis muncul di Gmail dalam label yang jelas. 
3. Panduan PDF singkat + rekaman layar (jika memungkinkan) yang menjelaskan cara menambah agen baru, mengganti nomor, atau menyesuaikan filter di masa depan.

Silakan ajukan jika Anda berpengalaman dengan Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business Suite, Zapier, atau alat serupa, dan dapat menyelesaikan semuanya secara aman tanpa melanggar kebijakan platform.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет настроить бизнес-Gmail на своём домене так, чтобы сообщения из WhatsApp Business и Instagram DM автоматически попадали в почту с разделением по меткам, плюс короткая PDF-инструкция и запись экрана. Бюджет низкий (25 USD), а объём работ широкий и зависит от верификации Meta.

title: Strategi Produk Digital di TikTok
description:
Saya ingin mulai menghasilkan cuan dengan menjual produk digital lewat TikTok. Saya sudah mantap memilih TikTok sebagai kanal utama dan butuh bantuan menyusun strategi sekaligus panduan praktis agar penjualan berjalan lancar.

Yang saya perlukan:
• Riset singkat untuk menentukan niche dan persona audiens yang potensial di TikTok. 
• Ide konten organik dan kerangka script video yang mendorong traffic ke halaman penjualan. 
• Rekomendasi format live, hashtag, serta jadwal posting optimal. 
• Alur funnel sederhana—dari penawaran di video hingga pembayaran (mis. link bio, landing-page, WhatsApp, atau marketplace). 
• Checklist tools pendukung (editing ringan, analitik TikTok, payment gateway) beserta tautan/alternatif gratis jika ada. 
• Saran taktik promosi berbayar sekiranya dibutuhkan, lengkap dengan estimasi biaya iklan awal.

Output yang saya harapkan berupa dokumen strategi terstruktur (PDF atau Google Docs) plus template kalender konten 30 hari. Sertakan contoh copy atau hook video agar mudah saya terapkan. Saya terbuka untuk sesi tanya jawab singkat setelah draft pertama selesai guna memastikan eksekusi mulus.

title: 3D модель робота в стиле PSX по фото с небольшими доработками
description:
Есть фото (разумеется созданная с ИИ), нужна 3D моделька LowPoly, c PSX текстурированием и с костями для анимаирования и запихивания её в игру.
По скольку это робот, то привязка костей должна быть жесткая (в плане не как для человека с растягиванием текстур и плавными весами... а просто кость целиком двигает деталь)
На счет доработок, как я и сказал картинка сделана с ИИ и по этому в ней есть много абсурда который нужно поправить.
На картинке робот девушка медик сделанная из санитарной буханки (УАЗ-452), в целом подправить нужно зад, живот и лицо.
На лице только текстурку перерисовать слегка (просто добавить сегментирование лица), в животе заделать дырки, а вот зад нужно переработать ибо ИИ никак не хотел делать именно то, что от него просили :)

Картинка № 1: Это изначальный внешний вид просто для общего понимания внешнего вида
Картинка № 2: Это как приблизительно должна выглядеть моделька
Картинка № 3: Живот. ИИ не заделало в нем дыры, хотя стиль PSX не располагает к такому, они должны быть заполнены черным шумом
Картинка № 4: Лицо. На нем нужно просто нарисовать линии имитирующие зазоры между отдельными частями в составе лица
Картинка № 5: Снова живот, но уже другая проблема. Там не должно быть позвоночника, нужны какие-нибудь механизмы (шланги/шарниры/петли... короче техническая свалка)
Картинка № 6: Колени. Просто добавить щитки наколенников в цвет корпуса.
Картинка № 7: Зад. Ну тут сложно описать текстом. На изначальной картинке ИИ сгенерировало человеческую форму с текстурой покрышек. Это нам не катит, там должно быть само целое колесо (ну, 2, справа и слева) как то соединенное с основным корпусом и ногой (колесо одновременно и ягодица и сустав) в каком наклоне оно будет и как крепиться я не знаю, это надо как то в процессе что ли пробовать.
Картинка № 8: Скелет. То как приблизительно должны располагаться кости (на каждый палец по 2 кости, шея с головой на отдельных костях, грудь/живот/таз так же на своих отдельных костях)

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет получить низкополигональную 3D-модель робота в стиле PSX по ИИ-картинке, с жёсткой риггингом под анимацию и доработкой деталей (лицо, живот, колени, зад). Это 3D-моделирование и арт, а не разработка по профилю.

title: AI Telegram FAQ Chatbot
description:
I need a Telegram chatbot that can field everyday customer questions by pulling answers directly from the PDFs and guides I’ll supply. The workflow is simple: when a user types a question, the bot searches those documents, returns a clear answer, and—if the answer genuinely isn’t there—tells the user it does not know. No hand-off to humans, no ticket creation, just an honest “I’m not sure” when the material is missing.

Here’s what matters to me:

• The knowledge base must be built from the documents I provide, so I can replace or add files later without rewriting code. 
• Response time should feel instant for the user; caching or a lightweight vector store is welcome. 
• The bot must run inside Telegram using the standard Bot API, preferably written in Python with libraries such as python-telegram-bot, LangChain, or similar LLM frameworks—open to your expert suggestion. 
• All answers should be returned in plain text; no rich media needed. 
• You’ll deliver the fully commented source code, a short read-me for deployment, and a brief video or screenshots showing the bot in action so I know it matches the spec.

If this sounds straightforward to you, let me know how you plan to connect the PDFs, which model you’d choose, and roughly how long you’ll need.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен Telegram-бот на Python, который отвечает на частые вопросы клиентов, используя только загруженные PDF и гайды. Если ответа в документах нет, бот честно сообщает, что не знает. База знаний должна обновляться без переписывания кода.
analysis.reply:
You want a Telegram bot that answers customer questions strictly from your own PDFs and guides, and says it doesn't know when the answer isn't there. I'd build it in Python with python-telegram-bot and LangChain: split the documents into chunks, store embeddings in a lightweight vector store like FAISS or Chroma, and have the bot retrieve the best matching passages and answer only from them. Adding or replacing files would mean re-running an ingestion script, with no code changes. Replies stay plain text, and a short cache keeps response times fast. I use modern tooling and AI assistants in development, so I can deliver a working version with commented code, a deployment README, and a demo video in about 5–7 days. Two questions: roughly how many files and pages will be in the knowledge base, and do you have a preferred LLM provider, or should I choose based on cost?

See live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен Telegram-бот, который отвечает на вопросы клиентов строго по вашим PDF и гайдам и честно говорит, что не знает, если ответа в документах нет. Я бы сделал его на Python с python-telegram-bot и LangChain: разбил бы документы на фрагменты, сохранил эмбеддинги в лёгком векторном хранилище вроде FAISS или Chroma, и бот находил бы наиболее подходящие фрагменты и отвечал только на их основе. Добавление или замена файлов потребовали бы только повторного запуска скрипта индексации, без изменений в коде. Ответы остаются простым текстом, а короткий кэш ускоряет ответы. Я использую современные инструменты и ИИ-ассистенты в разработке, поэтому могу сдать рабочую версию с комментированным кодом, README для деплоя и видео-демо примерно за 5–7 дней. Два вопроса: примерно сколько файлов и страниц будет в базе знаний, и есть ли предпочтение по LLM-провайдеру или выбрать по стоимости?

Посмотреть живые демо можно в моём портфолио: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: Finish a working handheld spirometer prototype (ESP32 + ultrasonic flow): Rev B PCB, firmware, 3 tested units
description:
We are MSTFA Industries, a Houston medical device startup. We have a handheld spirometer (lung function tester) that is designed, assembled and partly debugged, but it has not taken a flow measurement yet. We need an experienced embedded hardware engineer to take it from here to 3 working, bench-tested units and a complete file package we can hand to a board house. Speed matters more than polish: a better v2 comes later, and the right person is likely to get that work too.

WHAT EXISTS (full files shared after NDA)
- Small double-sided custom board: ESP32-S3, TI TDC1000 ultrasonic front end + TDC7200 time-to-digital converter, two 40 kHz ultrasonic transducers, OLED, Li-ion charging
- A pin-by-pin audit found 8 known faults, all in digital control pins or clock choice. The analog receive chain checked correct. TDC1000 SPI communication is verified.
- MicroPython firmware drivers for both TI chips, flow math, display and Bluetooth (not yet run end to end)
- 3D-printed flow tube and enclosure (CAD available)
- A designed backup path using a Sensirion SDP810 differential pressure sensor on the existing I2C port

WHAT WE NEED, BY MILESTONE (fixed price per milestone, paid through platform escrow)

M1. Review and plan (about 1 week)
Review the files, confirm the fault list, and recommend the fastest reliable path: fix the TI ultrasonic path, switch to a dedicated ultrasonic flow chip, or ship v1 on the pressure sensor. Deliver a written plan with a firm price and dates for M2 to M4.

M2. Rev B hardware
Schematic and PCB with all faults fixed. Add a temperature/humidity/pressure sensor (for example a BME280) for body-temperature correction. Run design-rule and assembly checks for JLCPCB. Deliver Gerbers, BOM with LCSC/DigiKey part numbers, pick-and-place file, and editable source files. We review before ordering, and we pay for fabrication and parts directly.

M3. Firmware and bring-up
On the Rev B boards: flow (L/s) and volume (L) sampled at 100 Hz or faster; FEV1, FVC, FEV1/FVC and PEF from a forced exhalation; body-temperature correction; a calibration routine; results on the OLED and over Bluetooth or serial. Source code in our Git repo with build instructions. MicroPython or C/C++ is fine, but justify a switch.

M4. Integration, testing and hand-off
3 complete working units in the printed tube and enclosure (update the CAD if needed; deliver STEP + STL). A bench report using a 3-liter calibration syringe: at least 3 speeds x 5 strokes, volume error for every stroke, and zero-flow drift over 10 minutes. Raw data included. Hand-off pack: assembly instructions, test procedure, known-issues list, all source files.

Accuracy: report the real numbers. Our long-term target is the ATS standard (within 2.5% or 0.050 L), but this phase is about a working, measured prototype, not clinical accuracy.

YOU HAVE
- Shipped at least one ultrasonic time-of-flight, flow or precision timing product (TDC1000/TDC7200, MSP430FR604x, TDC-GP30 or similar)
- Mixed-signal PCB design experience (EasyEDA, KiCad or Altium)
- ESP32 firmware experience

title: Industrial Data Diode Development
description:
Needed is a purpose-built data diode that can move live sensor information from operational technology (OT) networks to an IT-side monitoring zone without allowing a single bit of traffic back. The stream will carry data coming simultaneously from factory machines, power-water infrastructure, and building-automation sensors, so the solution has to tolerate mixed industrial protocols and a steady, continuous throughput. Some optical technology or another suitable suggested & approved by us may be used.

Core expectations 
• One-way hardware or hardened appliance that physically enforces the TX-only path 
• Interface options for common field protocols (Ethernet/ip, Profinet-iso tcp, with future pluggable protocol modules anticipated) so we can integrate each equipment class easily 
• Configuration utilities or scripts to map multiple sensor, tags, channels, validate packet integrity, and log transfer status on the receive side 
• Latency low enough for near-real-time dashboards; no backchannel acknowledgments permitted 
• Complete build documentation (KiCad, MS Word): schematic, Gerber files, bill of materials, firmware or , enclosure layout, and an operator guide focusing on installation , user, maintenance editable manuals. A anti-tempering device for the enclosure will be included. 24VDC power in controlled environment.
The attachment provides a better visual picture of our needs.
The orange section of the attached presentation covers hardware.
Green section of the presentation covers OS agnostic software. Embedded webserver for status, diags, configuration desirable with secure log in.
Blue section is not in your scope and will only be used for testing.
Initial testing can be performed on a test system from you; final testing will be with our SCADA and PLC systems (blue section).
Acceptance criteria :
The final unit must pass a loop-break test that proves zero reverse connectivity, successfully forward at least 10 Mbps of mixed sensor traffic for eight consecutive hours, and survive a 48-hour temperature-and-vibration soak aligned with standard industrial tolerances. Pentesting tools will be used & provided. Include a single HW unit for you & 1 for us during collateral testing. The unit you will use will be sent to us before the milestone 2 is released. 

Please outline your proposed architecture, any previous experience with unidirectional gateways, technology used with justification or critical-infrastructure security.
Any software tools used will be included in your bid & will become our sole property (with the rest of the solution) with no encumbrances or strings attached. Use of subscription services is discouraged.
The budget given is placeholder only, your bid must be final with amount & delivery time.
No upfront. A 1st milestone will be created after a acceptable remote demo is shown. 50% payment for milestone 1 after acceptable solution is delivered. 25% after job done. Final 25% payment will be after system delivery is with us for 2 months evaluation without any issues. Payment made only after all source code & support docs are delivered to us & approved for that milestone.
Respond only after reading full JD. Submit questions, changes, ideas with 1st response only. No changes allowed to your response till after award acceptance. The person responding will be the person doing the job. Any submissions must be done after full testing by you. Include items not tested & known issues. Only 1 testing session will be done by us before a final test by our team. Do not use any AI or BOT assistance in your communications with us. Those will be treated as fake, go in your disfavor & action taken. Please save yours & our time - do not bid, if you do not like our terms.

title: USDT Payment & Exchange Platform
description:
I want to launch a full-cycle USDT platform that lets a new user land on the site, verify their identity with a phone-number OTP flow, and immediately:

• buy USDT with either a bank card or a manual bank transfer 
• send and receive USDT internally between user wallets in real time 
• swap that USDT for the major coins people expect—Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, BNB—and any additional assets I later whitelist through an admin panel

The build needs native USDT wallet management, KYC/AML hooks during the phone verification step, and secure payment-card acquiring. A clean, mobile-first web interface is enough for the MVP; REST or GraphQL endpoints should sit underneath so we can expand to mobile apps later.

Please use well-established libraries for on-chain calls, custody, and rate sourcing, and structure the code so fees, limits, and new trading pairs can be added from the dashboard without redeploying. 

Deliverables:
1. Deployed web app (production ready) 
2. Source code with clear README and environment variables template 
3. Database schema + migration scripts 
4. API documentation (Postman or Swagger) 
5. Admin panel for user, wallet, and pair management 
6. Brief hand-over session walking me through server setup and future scaling steps

If you have previous work with USDT, fiat on-ramps, or phone-based KYC, that will stand out.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет запустить полноценную USDT-платформу: вход по OTP на телефон с KYC/AML, покупка USDT картой или банковским переводом, внутренние переводы и обмен на BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, а также админ-панель для комиссий и торговых пар. Бюджет 250 USD явно не покрывает такой объём, а часть функций (кастоди, эквайринг, обмен) требует лицензированных провайдеров.
analysis.reply:
You're describing a full USDT platform: phone OTP onboarding with KYC hooks, card and bank on-ramp, internal wallet transfers, swaps into BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and BNB, and an admin panel for fees and pairs. At $250, the full scope won't fit, so I'd suggest a first phase: phone OTP sign-up with a KYC hook, an internal USDT ledger with real-time transfers, and an admin panel for limits, fees and pairs. For custody, card acquiring and live rates, I'd connect established providers through their APIs rather than build those parts, so the regulated pieces stay with partners. I can deliver this phase in about two weeks, with a README, environment template and Swagger docs. Which KYC provider do you plan to use, and is the first release meant for testnet or live funds?

See my portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Вы описываете полноценную платформу для USDT: регистрацию по OTP на телефон с KYC-хуками, покупку через карту или банковский перевод, внутренние переводы между кошельками и обмен на BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP и BNB, а также админ-панель для комиссий и торговых пар. title: Telegram AI Support Chatbot
description:
I need an AI-driven Telegram bot that can step in as the first line of support, triaging and resolving customer requests or complaints around the clock. The bot should recognise the user’s intent, pull the right answer from our existing knowledge base, and only escalate to a human agent when it cannot solve the issue confidently. Speed is critical—I’d like to see a usable version live as soon as possible.

From a technical perspective, I’m open to the stack you prefer (Python, Node.js, Go, etc.) as long as you make full use of the Telegram Bot API and proven NLP tooling such as OpenAI models, Dialogflow, Rasa, or comparable frameworks. The end result must be easy for me to update with new FAQs, log all conversations for review, and run reliably on a cloud host of your choice.

Please highlight relevant experience building Telegram or customer-service chatbots and any live examples I can test. 

Deliverables 
• Production-ready Telegram bot with source code 
• Simple admin method for updating responses / hand-off rules 
• Deployment guide and hand-over call 

Acceptance criteria 
• Bot answers at least 80 % of test queries correctly without human intervention 
• Smooth escalation path to a live agent within the same chat thread 
• Deployed and validated on my Telegram account within the agreed timeline 

I’m eager to choose someone who can hit the ground running, so let me know how fast you can realistically deliver the first working build.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет Telegram-бота с ИИ для первой линии поддержки: он должен отвечать 24/7 по существующей базе знаний, определять намерение пользователя и передавать диалог живому оператору в том же чате, когда не уверен в ответе. Нужны админка для обновления FAQ и правил эскалации, логирование диалогов, деплой и передача проекта; бюджет 25 USD, срок горящий.
analysis.reply:
You need a Telegram bot that handles customer questions around the clock from your existing knowledge base, recognises intent, and hands the chat to a live agent in the same thread when it isn't confident. I'd build it in Python with aiogram for the Telegram side and OpenAI models for intent detection, with answers grounded in your FAQ via simple retrieval. Conversations would be logged to SQLite or Postgres, and FAQs and escalation rules would live in an editable file or sheet so you can update them without touching code. A first working version with FAQ answers and escalation should take about 3–5 days, followed by deployment and a handover call. Live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Montaje Tienda B2B Moda
description:
Busco que me configuren por completo una tienda online B2B de moda y complementos antes de la campaña de Navidad y Reyes. Aún no he decidido si alojarla en Shopify o WooCommerce; elegiré la plataforma que me resulte más sencilla de manejar, por lo que necesito que me expliques las ventajas de cada opción y luego la implementes.

Alcance esencial
• Estructura inicial con varias categorías, variantes de tallas y colores. 
• Precios visibles solo tras iniciar sesión como empresa. 
• Formulario de alta que solicite datos de empresa y número de identificación fiscal antes de otorgar acceso. 
• Condición de compra mínima: a partir de 5-10 unidades por referencia. 
• Catálogo y stock cargados desde un archivo CSV del proveedor; la actualización la haré de forma manual subiendo el CSV cuando corresponda, así que déjalo preparado para ello. 
• Sitio en español e inglés, con opción a que después yo mismo amplíe los textos. 

Lo que espero recibir

title: Build a Scalable Real-Money Ludo Platform
description:
Experienced iGaming Development Studio Wanted – Real Money Multiplayer Ludo & Gaming Platform

PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are seeking an established game development studio or a highly experienced multidisciplinary software engineering team to design, develop, deploy and maintain a proprietary real-money gaming platform built around Ludo.

Our objective is to create a premium, secure and internationally scalable gaming ecosystem combining multiplayer board games, standalone chance-based games, private gaming rooms and competitive tournaments.

This is not a conventional mobile game development project. It is a comprehensive iGaming platform combining game development, financial technology, real-time multiplayer infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a long-term technology partner with proven capabilities in these areas.

1. MULTIPLAYER GAMING ENGINE

- Traditional 4-player online Ludo.
- 2, 3, 4 and 6-player variations.
- Random online matchmaking.
- Private gaming rooms.
- Team-based game modes.
- Fast and express game modes.
- Multiplayer tournaments and championships.
- Real-time gameplay synchronization.
- Automatic reconnection and game recovery.
- Game history and replay.
- Anti-cheating and anti-collusion systems.

2. PROPRIETARY CHANCE-BASED GAMES

The platform will feature a catalogue of independent real-money games inspired by Ludo, dice games and other chance-based gaming mechanics.

The architecture must support the continuous integration of new proprietary games without requiring a complete redevelopment of the platform.

Detailed game mechanics, mathematical models and confidential specifications will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates under an NDA.

3. REAL MONEY GAMING & FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

- Secure integrated player wallet.
- Deposits and withdrawals.
- Mobile Money integration, particularly for African markets.
- International payment gateway integration, subject to provider approval.
- Secure stake management and game settlement.
- Automated winnings distribution.
- Commission management.
- Double-entry financial ledger.
- Financial reconciliation and reporting.
- Segregation of player and operator funds.
- Transaction monitoring.
- Fraud prevention.
- KYC and AML integration.
- Responsible gaming controls.

4. RNG & GAME INTEGRITY

- Secure server-side Random Number Generator.
- Auditable and independent game outcomes.
- Gaming mathematics and probability management.
- RTP calculation and verification.
- Protection against outcome manipulation.
- Architecture suitable for independent gaming certification, including applicable GLI standards.
- Comprehensive audit trails.

5. CENTRALIZED ADMINISTRATION PLATFORM

A professional back-office system covering:

- Executive dashboard.
- Player management.
- Live gaming operations.
- Game catalogue management.
- Financial operations and treasury.
- Deposit and withdrawal supervision.
- Tournament administration.
- Gaming statistics and business intelligence.
- Fraud and risk management.
- KYC and AML compliance.
- Responsible gaming management.
- Customer support.
- Regulatory reporting.
- Security and audit management.
- Role-based access control.
- System configuration and monitoring.

6. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

The solution must support:

- iOS.
- Android.
- Responsive web application.
- Progressive Web App (PWA).
- High-concurrency multiplayer infrastructure.
- Scalable cloud architecture.
- Modular gaming engine.
- Secure and documented APIs.
- Multi-language capabilities.
- Multi-currency architecture.
- Country-specific regulatory configurations.
- Automated testing and deployment.
- Disaster recovery and business continuity.
- Production monitoring and cybersecurity.

The technology stack should be proposed and justified by the development team.

Real-money operations will only be activated following the required regulatory authorizations, independent testing and payment provider approvals.

7. REQUIRED TEAM EXPERTISE

We expect the selected development partner to provide multidisciplinary expertise covering:

- iGaming software architecture.
- Senior game development.
- Real-time multiplayer networking.
- Frontend and backend engineering.
- Financial technology and payment integration.
- Database architecture.
- Gaming mathematics and RNG.
- UI/UX design.
- Cybersecurity.
- DevOps and cloud infrastructure.
- Quality assurance and software testing.
- Technical project management.

Previous experience developing production-ready real-money gaming platforms is essential.

Experience with online casinos, poker platforms, multiplayer betting games or regulated gaming systems will be highly valued.

8. PROJECT DELIVERABLES

- Complete functional and technical specifications.
- Software architecture documentation.
- Premium UI/UX design.
- Fully functional gaming applications.
- Proprietary multiplayer gaming engine.
- Standalone gaming modules.
- Secure financial infrastructure.
- Comprehensive administration platform.
- Complete custom-developed source code.
- Database schemas and documentation.
- API documentation.
- Automated test suites.
- Security and performance testing reports.
- Production deployment.
- Technical knowledge transfer.
- Maintenance and technical support plan.

9. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY & OWNERSHIP

All project-specific developments must become the exclusive property of our company upon payment of the corresponding milestones.

This includes custom-developed:

- Source code.
- Gaming engines.
- Software components.
- UI/UX designs.
- Database structures.
- Technical documentation.
- Gaming mathematics and proprietary game mechanics.

All pre-existing and third-party components, together with their licensing conditions, must be disclosed in advance.

Source code must be maintained in repositories controlled by our company throughout the development process.

We will not accept undisclosed white-label solutions, proprietary vendor lock-in or dependency on the developer for continued operation of the platform.

An NDA and intellectual property agreement will be mandatory.

10. DEVELOPMENT & CONTRACTUAL APPROACH

The project will be organized through clearly defined development milestones, including:

1. Discovery and technical architecture.
2. Game design and mathematical specifications.
3. UI/UX design and prototyping.
4. Core multiplayer gaming engine.
5. Financial infrastructure.
6. Standalone gaming modules.
7. Administration platform.
8. System integration.
9. Security, performance and quality assurance.
10. Regulatory certification readiness and deployment.
11. Post-launch maintenance and continuous development.

Each milestone must include clearly defined deliverables, acceptance criteria and demonstrable results.

11. APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Interested development studios must provide:

- Company profile and location.
- Years of experience in gaming development.
- Portfolio of completed iGaming projects.
- Links to live real-money gaming platforms previously developed.
- Description of their involvement in each referenced project.
- Proposed team composition.
- Relevant technical qualifications.
- Recommended technology stack.
- Preliminary architectural approach.
- Estimated development timeline.
- Detailed budget and milestone breakdown.
- Maintenance and support capabilities.
- Experience with gaming certification and regulated markets.

Please clearly indicate whether your development team is in-house or subcontracted.

Generic, automated or unsupported proposals will not be considered.

12. LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP

We are not looking for a one-time freelancer.

We are looking for a reliable technology partner capable of supporting the long-term development, maintenance, security, scalability and international expansion of our gaming ecosystem.

The initial platform represents the foundation of a broader proprietary iGaming business, with additional games, markets and business opportunities planned.

Project type: Full-scale custom iGaming platform.

Engagement: Long-term technology partnership.

Budget: Open to qualified and detailed commercial proposals.

Payment structure: Milestone-based.

Preferred candidates: Established iGaming development studios and experienced multidisciplinary software engineering teams.

title: Facebook Comment Safety Consultation PDF
description:
I am looking for a freelancer with real, hands-on experience in automated Facebook commenting bots and practical knowledge of Facebook comment ranking and integrity mechanisms. This is a knowledge/consulting project, not a coding project. I do not need you to write code for me. I need reliable, experience-based answers delivered as a detailed PDF.

Required competencies and experience. You must have personally worked with automated Facebook bots, not just general digital marketing or social media management. Your actual stack must include at least one of: Selenium, Playwright/Puppeteer, mobile automation such as Appium. You must be able to explain which one you used, for how long, and whether it was your own tooling or client projects. You must have practical experience with anti-detection setups: AdsPower or similar antidetect browsers, residential proxies, browser fingerprints, account isolation, rate limits, and Facebook restriction/ban patterns. You must be comfortable discussing greyhat/blackhat automation tactics realistically, including detection risk and account reputation damage. If you have not personally operated Facebook bots, please do not apply.

Proof of competence. In your proposal, include 2-3 concrete projects where you actually did this work. For each: what the bot did, which stack you used, how long you ran it, whether it was your own tool or a client project, and what results or problems you encountered. Also explain what you actually know about Facebook’s ranking and integrity algorithms, where you acquired that knowledge, and why it is reliable enough for me to invest money based on it. I understand that no one can guarantee 100% exact outcomes, and I prefer honest, experience-based answers over generic marketing claims.

My situation. I run a tutoring company in Poland. I use a fully automated Selenium + AdsPower script that searches for posts from people looking for tutoring and comments on them from 30 accounts. Each account has its own AdsPower profile. I use headed Selenium on Windows with residential IPs, and 1 IP is shared by 2 accounts because of costs. I post around 90 comments per day. Accounts are grouped in groups of 5 so as not to mix interactions between all accounts. After my comment is posted, 0-3 accounts wait 10-15 minutes, type the exact text of the post into Facebook search, click the post and try to like my comment. I do not have any mechanism that verifies whether my comments are visible in "Most relevant". I manually checked 30 posts recently: I could not find 14 of them or commenting was turned off; out of the remaining 16, 10 of my comments were in "Most relevant" mostly at the bottom, 5 were hidden or deleted, and 1 was at the bottom of "All comments". My goal is to move my comment to the first place in "Most relevant" by commenting and liking it. If necessary, I can buy more warmed-up accounts or comment on fewer posts. I can risk account bans. I have to use bots if I want to improve my situation. I cannot improve the quality of my comments, and making accounts more trustworthy will not improve their position very much without bots.

What I expect. We agree on a set of topics about Facebook algorithms, safety mechanisms, comment ranking and anything else I might need. Then we set a fair price, and you write a PDF with long, detailed answers to every topic, giving me the maximum knowledge and experience you can offer. The topics will include, in shortened form: proxy and account isolation, browser automation detection, behavioural patterns, comment ranking signals, tagging and link effects, timing between comments and likes, ban risk under one post, page/account architecture, comment variation, impact of likes on ranking, and account reputation recovery. I may add more specific points later. If you think I should know other things, add them. 

Please apply only if you can demonstrate the competencies above with concrete projects and honest confidence levels. I have logs, screenshots and a CSV sample I can share after selection.

title: Field Trial Participants - desktop app - Thermometers Supplied
description:
Join CoolRater’s winter 2026–27 field trial of a Windows app that measures the Heat-Transfer Coefficient of your home, a statistic used to support heat-pump sizing. Participants will install the app, connect an Octopus Energy account, provide half-hourly smart-meter data, and collect overnight temperatures using four Elitech RC-5+ loggers, which will be provided. Applicants must heat their home with a gas boiler and avoid using energy outside the home during trial sessions. Basic computer skills are sufficient; CSV editing and installing unsigned trial software are required. Five participants are sought each month from November 2026 to February 2027.

CoolRater is a desktop app which will measure the heat transfer coefficient HTC for a building, a function that has become increasingly important in recent years for use in sizing heat pumps. A field trial is being run this winter with these objectives:

1. To obtain temperature and energy data for a range of properties. Currently CoolRater has only been used for the author’s own property.

2. to obtain data from properties where the temperature varies between locations due to variations in insulation or heat distribution. For example close to a solid floor with no insulation, or in rooms which do not have double glazing.

3. To find out if users have any problems in using the app, or have any dislikes or need for additional features or improvements.

There are some specific requirements for participants:

1. The app only supports Windows (10 or 11);
2. heating must be with a gas boiler;
3. your energy supplier must be Octopus Energy, and you must be able to connect to the Octopus API, which means that you will have to live in the UK.
4. you must have a smart meter, configured to record energy use every 30 minutes. As a quick check that the smart meter and API is working correctly, there is a feature on the Octopus website where you can download smart meter data. Log in to your Octopus account, click your name top right, click My Energy, scroll down to "Get your energy geek on" you can download files of energy usage. Please download two days of energy data and attach it to your proposal, so that I can see that you have a working smart meter.
5. during the trial, which is only active at night, you will not be able to use energy for anything outside the house, like charging EVs.

To collect the temperature data you will be provided with four Elitech RC-5+ logging thermometers. To send you these, I will need your address. Exchanging contact details is discouraged by PPH rules, but is allowed after a proposal has been accepted if it is necessary to mail equipment. Note that a similar project is also posted which differs only in that participants buy their own thermometers, receive a higher amount as a result, and do not therefore need to provide their address.

A high level of computer expertise is not required but you will need to copy your API key from your Octopus account to the app, you may need to edit CSV files with Excel or LibraOffice, and install the app. As trial software it has not been possible to digitally sign it and it has had few downloads. Therefore the operating system will treat it with suspicion and advise you not to run it. You can run it against this advice by clicking “More Information” and “Run Anyway”.

The video https://youtu.be/HryknL9LGqQ gives instructions on using the app and shows what you will need to do as a participant in the field trial.

Criteria for Job Completion

As trial software its difficult to be certain of how well it will work. The app calculates the HTC for each inside thermometer by three different methods. If for any one of the thermometers the results agree to within 10%, then jobs a good’un. If they don’t, then this often indicates a problem with the thermometer being close to a heating source. So I would like you to repeat the test one or two times to get a better result. Return either one project file with the results agreeing to within 10%, or three project files from three separate attempts.

It is intended that there will be five participants in each of the months November 2026 to February 2027.

title: iOS App Figma Design
description:
We have a live iOS app in production (~50 or more screens but all share same layout). We need it recreated in Figma as a structured, component-based design system, not flat screen copies. A change made once to a component or variable must update every screen where it's used. Developers will build from the file using Figma Dev Mode and the Figma MCP server.

Requirements:

Use the live app (App Store / TestFlight access) and our screenshots as the reference.
Set up Figma Variables for colour, spacing, radius and typography (primitive → semantic), with Light / Dark modes, plus text styles.
Build reusable components with variants and properties covering all states (default, pressed, disabled, loading, empty, error): buttons, inputs, cards, list rows, nav bar, tab bar, sheets and dialogs.
Build every screen pixel-accurately from library components only: no detached instances, no hard-coded values.
Use Auto Layout everywhere, respecting iOS safe areas and Dynamic Type.
Use clear, code-friendly names (color/surface/primary, space/16, Button/Primary/Large).
Organise pages as Foundations / Components / Screens by flow, and publish the components as a library.
Build a clickable prototype of the main flows, and mark screens "Ready for dev".

Deliverables: editable Figma file transferred to our account, exported icons and assets (SVG, PNG @1x–3x), and a list of tokens and components.

Process: a paid first milestone (foundations, core components and 5 screens). We'll review it before the rest.

In your bid: start with "AUTO LAYOUT", show a past Figma design system (variables + component variants), and give your price and timeline.

title: business-management-system
description:
The platform centralizes store operations by connecting frontline checkout processing with inventory control, staff permissions, and automated end-of-day financial reporting. Visitors can jump straight to the Shop Online storefront, open the Dashboard, or Sign in to their business account.

Core Platform Features
Point of Sale (POS) Cashier Terminal: Enables fast sales processing with barcode/instant search, quantity adjustments, customer loyalty attachment, and receipt generation.

Verified Catalog & Zero-Stock Alerts: Organizes products by category, tracks cost-to-retail profit margins, and automatically labels items as 'EMPTY' as soon as inventory reaches zero.

Managerial Delegation & Approvals: Allows co-managers to add products and manage daily workflows while automatically alerting the store owner to any changes.

Audit Logs & Notification Bell: Provides a real-time notification center in the admin header to filter co-manager activity, inspect detailed audit logs, and clear logs as needed.

Automated Daily Reconciliation: Eliminates manual spreadsheet tallying by automatically calculating closing numbers across four key metrics:

Gross Daily Sales: Exact revenue from verified POS orders.

Sales Volume: Total units sold and deducted per category.

Inventory Status: Remaining stock levels and empty-item alerts.

Payment Breakdown: Revenue split across Cash, Card, and Mobile payments.

Multi-Currency & Business Settings: Admin-level controls configured for Ethiopian Birr (ETB) by default, alongside support for USD, EUR, and GBP, plus store contact details and an English (EN) language toggle.

Staff Hierarchy & Permissions
The system enforces role-based access control across three tiers:

Store Administrator (Store Owner & Executive Manager)

Permissions: Full control over the business profile, currency settings, end-of-day financial reconciliation reports, real-time co-manager notifications, and activity audit logs (including report deletion).

Access: Full Store Dashboard & Admin Console.

Co-Manager (Floor Supervisor & Shift Manager)

Permissions: Can add products, set prices, register customers directly, and approve catalog modification requests submitted by cashiers. All actions are logged and trigger automatic notifications to the admin.

Access: Catalog, Sales, Approvals & Personal Profile.

Employee / Cashier (Frontline Staff)

Permissions: Operates the POS checkout terminal and looks up or registers customers. Any product or price changes they submit are held pending managerial approval.

Access: POS Station, Customer Roster & Assigned Workspace.

Page Navigation & Actions
Header & Hero: Features quick links to Shop Online and the Dashboard, alongside theme (light/dark mode) and language (GB EN) toggles.

Based on its architecture—specifically high-speed barcode checkout, zero-stock (EMPTY) alerts, profit margin tracking, multi-tier staff permissions, and automated end-of-day cash/card/mobile reconciliation—this system is built for high-turnover, inventory-based retail businesses where daily stock tracking and cashier accountability are critical.

While the page explicitly mentions retail stores, supermarkets, and enterprise merchants (with branding for Lexi Electronics and Yoni Mini Market), it is well-suited for the following types of businesses:

Supermarkets & Mini-Markets: Ideal for fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) with high daily transaction volumes, barcode scanning, and instant EMPTY alerts when shelf stock runs out.

Electronics & Mobile Phone Shops: Fits stores selling high-value items where cost-to-retail profit margin tracking, strict co-manager approval rules for price changes, and detailed audit logs prevent unauthorized discounting or stock loss.

Pharmacies & Drugstores: Works well for tracking medicine stock levels, preventing out-of-stock surprises on essential items, and separating pharmacist/manager catalog control from frontline cashier checkout.

Cosmetics, Beauty & Boutique Retail: Useful for managing categorized product catalogs, customer loyalty registration at checkout, and multi-currency pricing (ETB, USD, EUR, GBP).

Hardware, Auto Parts & Building Supply Stores: Helps manage large, categorized inventories with varying unit quantities and daily sales volume breakdowns per category.

Wholesale & Distribution Outlets: Supports bulk quantity adjustments at checkout, profit-margin monitoring, and end-of-day financial reconciliation across multiple payment methods.

Footer & Portal Links: Provides direct navigation to Features, Staff Roles, Daily Reports, the Staff Portal, and Register Store.

title: Поднять БД из файлов MySQL и развернуть на WordPress
description:
техническое задание 
Задача: Поднять БД из сырых бинарных файлов MySQL и развернуть под ключ два сайта на WordPress («Изол» и «Окожушка») на новом хостинге Sprinthost. 
Исходники (архив с прошлого VPS): 
1.Папки public_html обоих сайтов. 
2.Бинарные файлы MySQL/InnoDB из /var/lib/mysql (папки баз, системная mysql, ibdata1, ib_logfile0, ib_buffer_pool, mysql_upgrade_info). 
Что нужно сделать (под ключ): 
1.Восстановление БД и перенос: Поднять совместимую версию MySQL/MariaDB из сырых файлов, снять чистые SQL-дампы, импортировать в новые БД на Sprinthost и прописать доступы в wp-config.php. 
2.Домены, SSL и редиректы: Привязать домены к Sprinthost (A-записи и почтовые MX, SPF, DKIM), выпустить SSL-сертификаты и настроить 301-редирект с http на https. 
3.Настройка окружения и ссылки: Подобрать совместимую версию PHP без ошибок в логах. Настроить .htaccess и ЧПУ (после переноса с VPS все внутренние страницы должны открываться без ошибок 404). 
4.Почта и проверка: Создать доменные ящики / настроить SMTP в WordPress, проверить отправку заявок с форм и калькуляторов, убедиться в работоспособности админок и базовой чистоте файлов от шеллов с прошлого сервера. 
Требование: Опыт восстановления баз из сырых файлов /var/lib/mysql обязателен. Доступы к Sprinthost и ссылку на архив скину после согласования.

analysis.summary_ru: Восстановление MySQL/InnoDB из сырых файлов /var/lib/mysql, перенос двух сайтов на WordPress на новый хостинг Sprinthost, настройка доменов, SSL, почты и безопасности. Это в первую очередь администрирование и миграция сервера, а не разработка, и бюджет 3000 ₽ для такого объёма работ низкий.

title: Dual-Side Service Booking App
description:
I need a mobile application that lets customers and service providers interact around three core workflows: booking, task tracking, and schedule management. Customers should be able to browse a marketplace of providers, see real-time availability, reserve a slot, pay, rate the service, and share their experience through a light social feed. On the other side, providers must have a dashboard to accept or decline bookings, create internal tasks, and view their staff roster in a calendar view.

The app must keep both roles in a single code-base (iOS and Android) with a secure login, push notifications, and a clean admin panel where I can edit listings, adjust working hours, and moderate ratings or social posts. 

Acceptance criteria – once installed, a new user can: 
• sign up as customer or provider 
• search or list services in the marketplace 
• complete a booking with confirmation and payment stub 
• open a personal task list and mark items done 
• view or publish ratings that become visible instantly 
• post a photo or short update in the social channel 
• receive a push notification for every status change 

Source code, database schema, and brief build instructions are part of the final hand-off so I can continue maintenance in-house.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет одно кроссплатформенное мобильное приложение для iOS и Android, где клиенты бронируют услуги у провайдеров, а провайдеры управляют заявками, задачами и расписанием персонала. В задачу входят ратинги, социальная лента, push-уведомления и админ-панель для модерации.
analysis.reply:
You need a single cross-platform app where customers book services and providers manage bookings, tasks and staff schedules, plus ratings, a social feed, push notifications and an admin panel. I'd build it as one codebase for iOS and Android, starting with the core flows: role-based sign-up, provider listings with live slot availability, booking with confirmation, and push notifications for every status change. Ratings, the feed and moderation tools would follow in the same sprint structure. With a modern stack and AI-assisted development, I could deliver a first working version in about 4–6 weeks, with source code, database schema and build instructions handed over. The scope is large for the budget, so I'd suggest keeping the first release to your acceptance criteria and moving the rest to a second phase. Do you already have a preferred cross-platform framework, and is the social feed required in the first release? You can see my live demos at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно одно кроссплатформенное приложение, где клиенты бронируют услуги, а провайдеры управляют заявками, задачами и расписанием персонала, плюс ратинги, социальная лента, push-уведомления и админ-панель. Я бы сделал одну кодовую базу для iOS и Android, начав с основных сценариев: регистрация с выбором роли, карточки провайдеров с актуальной доступностью слотов, бронирование с подтверждением и push-уведомления о каждом изменении статуса. Ратинги, лента и инструменты модерации пойдут следующими спринтами. С современным стеком и разработкой с помощью ИИ-ассистентов я могу сдать первую рабочую версию примерно за 4–6 недель, с исходным кодом, схемой базы данных и инструкцией по сборке. Объём большой для бюджета, поэтому предлагаю ограничить первый релиз вашими критериями приемки, а остальное вынести во второй этап. У вас уже есть предпочитаемый кроссплатформенный фреймворк и нужна ли социальная лента в первом релизе? Мои живые демо здесь: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Excel Invoice Recording & Reconciliation - 26/11/2026 13:08 EST
description:
My income, expense, and invoice data lives in a set of Excel/Google Sheets files, but the information has outgrown the simple tabs I created. I need a detail-oriented bookkeeper to bring structure to these sheets by accurately recording every transaction, matching each sale to its corresponding payment, and ensuring all outstanding invoices have a clear status. 

The core of the assignment is two-fold: first, capture and organise the raw numbers so every line item is entered consistently; second, reconcile the sales, invoice, and payment records so that each figure ties back without discrepancies. Once the cleanup is complete, I want a concise reconciliation summary that I can reference quickly for month-end reviews. 

Deliverables 
• Updated Excel/Google Sheets workbook with all income, expenses, and invoices recorded and cross-checked 
• Reconciliation tab or report showing matched payments vs. sales and any variances clearly flagged 
• Brief overview outlining issues found, actions taken, and recommendations for keeping the data current going forward 

Accuracy and clarity are key. If you have a reliable workflow for handling large Excel datasets and a sharp eye for resolving mismatches, I’m ready to get started right away.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент просит навести порядок в таблицах Excel/Google Sheets с доходами, расходами и счетами: вручную внести все операции, сверить продажи с платежами и подготовить сводку для закрытия месяца. Это бухгалтерская работа по ручному вводу и сверке данных, а не разработка, поэтому проект не подходит под услуги.
questions: Нужна ли разовая ручная сверка данных или вы хотите регулярную автоматическую синхронизацию между таблицами и платежной системой?
Из каких источников приходят платежи (банк, платежная система, CRM) и есть ли у них выгрузки или API?

title: Busy ERP Automatic Data Sync
description:
I need a seamless link that pushes data from my existing ERP straight into Busy the moment it is created or updated. The sync must cover three record groups—sales invoices with customer details, purchase bills with supplier details, and all stock items with their current quantities—so that Busy is always holding the same information my own system shows in real-time. 

My ERP is fully accessible through REST endpoints, and I expect you to use Busy’s API, SDK, or any other officially supported method so the transfer remains reliable and update-safe. Once set up, no manual clicks should be required; the integration should watch for new or modified records and post the corresponding JSON (or XML, if Busy prefers) instantly. 

Deliverables: 
• A deployable integration service or module with configurable credentials and endpoints 
• Clear installation and configuration instructions for my IT team 
• A short test plan plus evidence that data is flowing correctly for all three record types 

If you have previous experience with Busy integrations, inventory modules, or high-volume API automation, you’ll jump right to the top of my list.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет автоматическую синхронизацию данных из своей ERP в Busy: счета на продажу, счета поставщиков и остатки товаров должны передаваться сразу при создании или изменении записи, без ручных действий. Нужны сервис с настраиваемыми учетными данными, инструкция по установке и тест-план.
analysis.reply:
You need ERP records (sales invoices, purchase bills, stock items) pushed into Busy as soon as they change, with no manual steps. I would build a small service that listens to your ERP's REST endpoints (webhooks if available, otherwise short-interval polling based on change timestamps), maps each record group to the format Busy's import interface accepts, and posts it with retries and a log of every transfer. Credentials and endpoints would sit in a config file, and the test plan would check all three record types end to end. A first working version covering all three groups would take roughly 2–3 weeks, depending on how Busy's import is set up.

Two questions: do your ERP endpoints support webhooks or change timestamps, and which Busy version and edition do you run?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно, чтобы записи из ERP (счета на продажу, счета поставщиков, товарные остатки) сразу передавались в Busy при создании или изменении, без ручных действий. Я бы сделал небольшой сервис, который отслеживает REST-эндпоинты вашей ERP (если есть вебхуки, то их, иначе опрос с коротким интервалом по меткам времени изменений), приводит каждую группу записей к формату, который принимает импорт Busy, и отправляет их с повторными попытками и журналом каждой передачи. Учетные данные и эндпоинты будут в конфигурационном файле, а тест-план проверит все три типа записей от начала до конца. Первая рабочая версия со всеми тремя группами займет примерно 2–3 недели, в зависимости от того, как настроен импорт в Busy.

Два вопроса: поддерживают ли эндпоинты вашей ERP вебхуки или метки времени изменений, и какую версию и редакцию Busy вы используете?

Портфолио с живыми демо: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Intricate 12.7 mm Pendant CAD - Ganesha Idol
description:

Here is the vision:

• Front: fully detailed relief that mirrors the artwork exactly. 
• Back: kept mostly flat so the overall thickness stays wearable. 
• Look: the end goal is a darkened antique silver finish, though I’m open to your advice on alloy choice and any plating or patination steps that will intensify those shadows.

What I need from you
1. Precision 3D sculpting/CAD that captures the tiniest textures at this scale. 
2. A high-resolution resin or wax print so I can inspect the piece in hand before casting. 
3. A digital preview (renders at several angles) for approval prior to printing. 
4. Optional production support for casting the final piece in silver or a compatible metal.

When you reply, please confirm whether the level of detail is achievable at ½-inch, note which technologies (e.g., DLP/SLA resin printing, direct metal printing, lost-wax casting) you would use, and break down your pricing for: 
• CAD design 
• Prototype print 
• Final cast pendant 

I can share the artwork immediately for a quick feasibility check. I look forward to hearing how you would bring this miniature masterpiece to life.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет получить 3D-модель миниатюрного кулона 12,7 мм (Ганеша) по референсу, печать прототипа в смоле или воске и литьё в серебре. Это ювелирное CAD-моделирование и производство, а не разработка программного продукта.

title: Mobile Detailing CRM Setup
description:
I run a mobile detailing service and I’m ready to replace my spreadsheets and calendar apps with a single CRM that lets my office staff stay on top of every job. 
The first capability I need is straightforward: staff must be able to create a booking, choose the service package, select the date, time, and the customer’s location, then see that job automatically appear on a master schedule. No self-service portal for customers—only our in-house team should touch the booking screen.

Core workflow I’m aiming for 
• A staff member enters a new or returning customer. 
• They pick the detailing package, date, time, and address. 
• The system confirms availability, reserves the slot, and drops the job onto a calendar that the whole team can see in real time. 
• Automatic email/SMS confirmations to the customer would be great, but the calendar accuracy is the non-negotiable piece.

Beyond the calendar view, I want quick access to each customer’s history and job status (scheduled, in progress, completed). If the platform you recommend can later add quoting or invoicing modules, that’s a plus, but it does not have to be part of this first release.

Website touch-point 
My current website already collects basic enquiry forms. I’d like those submissions to land directly in the CRM as new leads so staff can convert them to bookings without retyping. A simple form embed or webhook is fine; I don’t need full customer self-booking at this stage.

Please outline: 
• The CRM or tech stack you propose (e.g., Zoho, HubSpot, Monday.com, custom build, etc.). 
• How you’ll handle the booking-to-calendar flow and the website lead capture. 
• Timeframe to deliver a working, tested system my team can start using.

If you have past experience setting up service-industry CRMs with route-based scheduling, let me know. I’m ready to move quickly once I see a solid plan.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужна внутренняя CRM для мобильного детейлинга: сотрудники создают запись (клиент, пакет, дата, время, адрес), система проверяет доступность и показывает заказ в общем календаре в реальном времени. Также нужно, чтобы заявки с сайта автоматически попадали в CRM как лиды. Бюджет очень ограничен (25 USD) для такого объёма.
analysis.reply:
You need a staff-only booking screen that takes the customer, package, date, time and address, checks availability, reserves the slot and shows the job on a shared live calendar, with website enquiries flowing in as leads. I would build this as a lightweight custom web app (React frontend with a small Node or Supabase backend) rather than stack a generic CRM, so the slot locking and calendar behave exactly as described and route-based scheduling can be added later. The first milestone would be the booking-to-calendar flow plus the form-to-lead webhook, tested with your team; email/SMS confirmations would follow. For a first working version I estimate about 1–2 weeks, depending on scope. Two questions: how many staff will use the calendar at the same time, and does your website support sending webhooks, or would a form embed be easier?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен экран бронирования только для сотрудников: он принимает клиента, пакет, дату, время и адрес, проверяет доступность, резервирует слот и показывает заказ в общем календаре в реальном времени. Заявки с сайта должны автоматически попадать в CRM как лиды. Я бы сделал это как легковесное веб-приложение на заказ (фронтенд на React, небольшой бэкенд на Node или Supabase), а не подключал готовую CRM, чтобы блокировка слотов и календарь работали именно так, как описано, а маршрутное планирование можно было добавить позже. Первым этапом будут поток «бронирование → календарь» и вебхук «форма → лид», протестированные вместе с вашей командой; подтверждения по email/SMS пойдут следом. По оценке, первая рабочая версия займёт примерно 1–2 недели в зависимости от объёма. Два вопроса: сколько сотрудников будут одновременно работать с календарём и поддерживает ли ваш сайт отправку вебхуков, или проще будет встроить форму?

Портфолио с живыми демо: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
