title: Miniaturize an ESP32 laundry sensor into an AirTag-sized puck (5 prototype units)
description:
We are building a small magnetic puck, about the size of an Apple AirTag, that sticks to the outside of any washer or dryer, senses when vibration stops, and triggers a text message when the load is done. The sensing approach is proven by an open-source project (see below). We need an experienced hardware engineer to miniaturize it into a polished, pocket-sized product and build 5 working prototype units for a two-week user test.

Working title: Smart Laundry Alert. No brand name is locked yet.

Starting point (reference build)
GitHub: https://github.com/boscacci/laundry-done
An ESP32 laundry-finished detector for apartment washer/dryer stacks. ESP32 DevKit board + LSM6DS3 or LIS3DH accelerometer breakout, in a small project box, powered by a USB battery bank. It sticks to the outside of the machine, watches vibration, and sends a phone notification when the machine has been quiet long enough to count as done. Use this firmware and approach as your starting point. Do not reinvent the sensing.

Scope of work
1. Prove the sensing first (required, before miniaturizing). On a dev board, demonstrate the puck reliably telling a running machine from a done one on a real washer and dryer. Confirm the done rule: 4 minutes of quiet after running counts as done. Report the false-alarm rate. Do not skip this step.
2. Miniaturize to AirTag size. Custom PCB, about 32 mm diameter, slightly thicker than an AirTag to fit the battery. ESP32 (C3 or S3), accelerometer (LSM6DS3, LIS3DH, or equivalent), small rechargeable LiPo battery with USB-C charging, one small LED (green = load done), magnet mount with a grippy silicone ring on the base.
3. Firmware. Wi-Fi, vibration sampling, done detection, and a signed HTTP POST to a configurable HTTPS endpoint when a load finishes. The cloud service and SMS sending are a separate job and NOT in this scope. The puck only needs to report to the endpoint.
4. Enclosure. Small, matte black, clean and pocketable. 3D-printed is fine for the prototype batch.
5. Build and ship 5 working units to the client (US address provided on hire), each tested on a real washer and dryer before shipping.

What you need
- Proven experience with ESP32, battery-powered devices, and compact or wearable PCB design. Show examples of similar completed boards, especially small or wearable devices.
- Experience with low-power design and 3D-printed enclosures is a plus.
- US-based is preferred for shipping speed and communication, not required.

What we provide
- A one-page product sketch (idea, how it works, test plan, competition).
- Design renders of the target puck.
- The GitHub reference repo above.

Budget
$650-900 all-inclusive for design, parts, fabrication, assembly, and shipping of 5 assembled prototype units. Comparable miniaturize-ESP32 design jobs on this platform have averaged around $500-600 for design alone; this budget covers the full prototype batch.

How bids are evaluated
- Every bid must include an itemized cost breakdown: design, parts, fabrication, assembly, and shipping, each on its own line. Bids without a breakdown will not be considered.
- Bids at the top of the $650-900 budget will be scrutinized closely. The budget is a ceiling, not a target. Show us what each dollar is for, and where you found savings.

Timeline
3-4 weeks from hire to 5 tested units shipped.

To apply
- Examples of similar completed PCB designs (especially compact or wearable devices).
- Your estimated timeline and an itemized cost breakdown (design, parts, fabrication, assembly, shipping).
- Any questions about the scope before you bid.

Основная часть работы — проектирование печатных плат и сборка устройств, что выходит за рамки услуг фрилансера.

title: API Documentation Restructure & Enhancement

description:

Beyond the ordering flow, I also need you to create and hand over a Meta Business / Ads account and a Google AdSense account so I can start running promotions as soon as we open. Please include basic pixel or tag integration on the site and in the app so campaign tracking is ready.

Key deliverables I’m expecting:
• Responsive restaurant website with secure ordering, menu management, and real-time order dashboard 
• iOS and Android apps that mirror the website’s ordering experience and sync all data 
• Payment gateway setup for online card and wallet transactions only 
• Pickup-or-delivery toggle with address validation for delivery orders 
• Meta Business Suite setup, initial ad account configuration, and pixel installed 
• Google AdSense account creation and code placed on informational pages

I’m open to the tech stack you prefer—WordPress + WooCommerce, Laravel, React Native, Flutter, or another solid solution—as long as it delivers a smooth user experience and can scale. Let me know the framework you recommend, your timeline, and any similar projects you have shipped.

I'd build it on a modern stack, add address validation for delivery, and connect live order updates, then add native apps later if you need them. The core ordering flow would take about 3–4 weeks. The Meta and Google ad accounts should be registered under your business details, and I can install the pixel and AdSense code once they're set up. title: Nike-Inspired Fashion E-Commerce Build
description:
I want a slick, Nike-style online store built with pure HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The look has to be clean, modern and fast, with subtle animations that feel premium rather than flashy. 

Core pages and sections 
• A striking, scroll-friendly homepage that immediately showcases the brand vibe. 
• A stylish, sticky navigation bar that stays intuitive on desktop, tablet and mobile. 
• Product collection pages focused on sportswear and sneakers, each with interactive galleries (zoom, colour swap, slide-through thumbnails). 
• “Try the Look” blocks where full outfits appear on a model and individual items link straight to their detail pages. 

Shopping experience 
Visitors need to browse items, view detailed descriptions, then add products to a cart and place an order in a friction-free flow. I’m open to whichever lightweight cart logic you prefer as long as it feels seamless and keeps the tech stack to HTML/CSS/JS. 

Visual & performance expectations 
Smooth transitions between sections, micro-animations on buttons or image hovers, and responsive layouts that adapt perfectly from widescreen down to small phones. Code should be clean, well-commented and optimised so pages load quickly even on mobile data.

Deliverables 
- Full front-end source code with clear folder structure 
- Sample product JSON (or similar) ready for easy data swap-out 
- Brief setup/readme so I can run and update the site locally 

If you have recent e-commerce examples—especially sports or fashion—send links so I can gauge fit. Looking forward to seeing how you’d bring this concept to life.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет премиальный интернет-магазин спортивной одежды и кроссовок в стиле Nike на чистом HTML, CSS и JS, с интерактивными галереями, блоками «Try the Look», корзиной и JSON-каталогом товаров. Бюджет небольшой для такого объёма, поэтому стоит заранее согласовать приоритеты.
analysis.reply:
You want a premium, Nike-style storefront in plain HTML, CSS and JS: a scroll-driven homepage, a sticky responsive nav, sneaker and sportswear collections with zoomable galleries and colour swaps, "Try the Look" outfit blocks linking to product pages, and a lightweight cart with a friction-free order flow. Since there's no framework, I'd build static pages that render from a JSON product catalogue, so you can swap data without touching the markup. Animations would be CSS transitions with IntersectionObserver, kept light so mobile pages load fast. Given the budget, I'd deliver the homepage, one collection page, the product page and the cart first, then polish the rest. Estimated timeline is about a week for the full set. Two questions: how many products and colour variants do you expect at launch, and do you have photos ready or should I use placeholders? You can see live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен премиальный магазин в стиле Nike на чистом HTML, CSS и JS: главная страница с анимациями при прокрутке, адаптивная закреплённая навигация, коллекции кроссовок и спортивной одежды с галереями с зумом и сменой цвета, блоки «Try the Look» со ссылками на карточки товаров и лёгкая корзина с простым процессом заказа. Анимации выполнил бы через CSS-переходы и IntersectionObserver, оставив их лёгкими, чтобы страницы быстро открывались на мобильном интернете. С учётом бюджета сначала сделал бы главную, одну страницу коллекции, карточку товара и корзину, а потом доработал остальное. Ориентировочный срок на весь объём — около недели. title: Карьеру до сих пор часто представляют в виде лестницы: пришел младшим специалистом, стал старшим, потом руководителем. Хотя по себе замечаю, что двигался вбок чаще, чем вверх. И в итоге этот опыт тоже
description:
Карьеру до сих пор часто представляют в виде лестницы: пришел младшим специалистом, стал старшим, потом руководителем. Хотя по себе замечаю, что двигался вбок чаще, чем вверх. И в итоге этот опыт тоже оказался полезным.
Оказывается, это уже полноценный тренд. На форуме «Коммерсанта» директор по организационному развитию и автоматизации HR-процессов Т2 Ольга Финоченко рассказала, что линейную карьеру постепенно сменяет портфельная. Это не только движение вверх, но и горизонтальные переходы, смена функций и участие в проектах с другими командами.
Ещё один тренд: сотрудники хотят лучше понимать, какие возможности для профессионального и карьерного развития есть в компании именно для них. Им важно, чтобы работодатель помог найти подходящее направление с учётом их интересов, опыта и запросов, а не предлагал универсальные решения. Поэтому растёт спрос на профориентационные консультации.
В Т2 уже запустили проект карьерного консультирования. Каждый сотрудник может посетить несколько сессий в год. Эксперты помогают разобраться в накопленном опыте и вместе с сотрудником составляют индивидуальный план достижения карьерных целей.
Мне бы такая возможность в свое время пригодилась. В общем, карьера — это не только про должность. Иногда шаг в сторону дает гораздо больше, чем шаг вверх.

analysis.summary_ru: Текст статьи или поста о трендах карьерного развития: горизонтальная «портфельная» карьера и карьерное консультирование в компании Т2. Это не запрос на разработку.

title: Shopify App developer
description:
I need a custom Shopify app that keeps a constant eye on my stock levels and tells me—instantly—when any item is running low or hits zero. The app’s core job is two-fold: (1) fire off low- and out-of-stock alerts, and (2) generate clear, scheduled reports on overall store activity so I can act before problems snowball.

Workflow I’m after 
• Real-time monitoring of every SKU via the Admin API and webhooks. 
• Adjustable thresholds per product (bulk edit welcomed). 
• Alerts delivered by email first; Slack or in-app notifications are a nice bonus if they’re straightforward to wire up. 
• A lightweight dashboard inside Shopify (Polaris-styled) summarising current low-stock items, recent alert history, and a quick sales / inventory snapshot. 
• Daily and weekly summary reports sent automatically—CSV export optional but appreciated.

Tech notes 
A private app is fine; no need for public-app review. Build in Node.js or Ruby—whichever you’re fastest with—and structure it so I can host on Heroku or any standard VPS. Clean, well-commented code is important; I’ll be maintaining it after hand-off.

Deliverables 
• Full source code with README covering setup, environment variables, and deployment. 
• Step-by-step installation guide plus a brief user manual (thresholds, scheduling, adding notification channels). 
• One live demo on my dev store proving alerts and reports work as described.

Acceptance criteria: changing a product’s threshold triggers the correct alert, the dashboard loads error-free in the admin, and scheduled emails land on time. If you know Shopify APIs, webhooks, and Polaris, this should be a straightforward build—let’s get started.

title: Limpiar malware y recuperar WordPress
description:
he recibido el siguiente ensaje y mi web no funciona:Hola:
Nuestros sistemas de seguridad han detectado contenido malicioso dentro del archivo wp-config.php de tu página web dintelobras.es, que utiliza el gestor de contenido WordPress.
Este archivo es uno de los más sensibles de la instalación, ya que contiene los datos de conexión a la base de datos (nombre, usuario, contraseña y servidor) y las claves de seguridad y "salts" que WordPress emplea para cifrar las sesiones. Al haber quedado expuesto su contenido, un atacante podría conectarse directamente a tu base de datos, crear usuarios administradores, añadir o modificar contenido sin tu autorización, mantener sesiones válidas suplantando a tus usuarios y comprometer los datos de tus visitantes.
Te escribo para informarte de esta situación y ayudarte a proteger tu sitio lo antes posible. Quiero aclararte que tu página web sigue operativa como siempre, pero te aconsejo que actúes rápido por tu seguridad y la de tus usuarios. Para solucionar esto, te recomiendo realizar las siguientes tareas:
1. Cambiar la contraseña de la base de datos: modifícala de inmediato desde tu Panel de Control y recuerda actualizar ese mismo cambio en el archivo wp-config.php para que tu web siga funcionando.
2. Regenerar las claves de seguridad (salts): sustituye los valores de las claves AUTH_KEY, SECURE_AUTH_KEY, LOGGED_IN_KEY, NONCE_KEY y sus correspondientes "salts" en wp-config.php. Puedes generar valores nuevos desde https://api.wordpress.org/secret-key/1.1/salt/. Esto invalidará todas las sesiones abiertas, incluidas las del atacante.
3. Cambiar las contraseñas: modifica la clave de todos los usuarios administradores de WordPress, así como las de tus accesos FTP y del propio Panel de Control.
4. Revisar los usuarios administradores: elimina todos los usuarios que no reconozcas o que no correspondan a personas de tu confianza.
5. Actualizar WordPress: instala la última versión disponible del CMS, así como de todos los plugins y temas que tengas activos, ya que una vulnerabilidad en alguno de ellos suele ser la vía por la que se llega a leer este archivo.
6. Proteger el archivo wp-config.php: comprueba que sus permisos sean restrictivos (640 o 644) y que no sea accesible desde el navegador. También puedes bloquear su acceso desde el archivo .htaccess.
7. Instalar un plugin especializado en seguridad: puedes utilizar una herramienta de confianza como, por ejemplo, WordFence, y lanzar un análisis completo de archivos.
8. Revisar el contenido: examina las tablas de tu base de datos y los archivos de tu espacio web (especialmente los ficheros PHP modificados recientemente) para asegurarte de no dejar rastro del malware.
Te envío este aviso únicamente a título informativo para que puedas tomar las medidas preventivas oportunas y mantener a salvo tu proyecto.
segundo:Hola:
Nuestros sistemas de seguridad han detectado un comportamiento anómalo en las visitas a tu hosting dintelobras.es, y creemos que tiene un agujero de seguridad en el código. Hemos detectado, entre otras, estas URL que sospechamos que están infectadas con malware:
/srv/vhost/dintelobras.es/home/html/wp-config.php
Para tu información, el WordPress que usas en tu web tiene estos componentes que no están en la última versión. Te recomendamos mantener siempre actualizado el core, los plugin y los temas para evitar potenciales problemas de seguridad:
********************************************************

WordPress: (Ver: 6.2.2)
Ruta instalación: /html/nuevawebold

core => wordpress v6.2.2
plugin => addons-for-elementor v7.7.1
plugin => contact-form-7 v5.7.7
plugin => elementor-pro v3.13.2
plugin => elementor v3.13.4
plugin => google-site-kit v1.102.0
plugin => ht-contactform v1.1.6
plugin => really-simple-ssl v7.0.3
plugin => theme-demo-import v1.1.1
plugin => wordpress-seo v20.8

********************************************************
Por tu seguridad y la de tus usuarios, hemos tomado estas medidas:
• Renombrar los ficheros con malware. Si un archivo se llamaba, por ejemplo, formulario_web.php ahora se llamará formulario_web.php._malware. Así, minimizamos el daño que pueda hacerte a ti y a tus clientes.
• Limitar páginas con formularios. Hemos deshabilitado en tu hosting las peticiones http de tipo POST, que son las que utilizan las páginas que contienen un formulario (apartado de contacto, página de alta de clientes, etc.). Ahora, solo se pueden completar los formularios desde direcciones IP de España.
El resto de funcionalidades de tu hosting siguen 100% operativas.
Te recomendamos que actúes porque, aunque tu página web siga funcionando sin formularios ahora, tiene un problema de seguridad que puede comprometer tus datos y los de tus usuarios.
Es importante que realices las siguientes tareas en el menor tiempo posible:
• Actualiza y verifica todos los plugins que consideres necesarios para el correcto funcionamiento de tu Web.
• Revisa el contenido de tu sitio web y asegúrate de no dejar rastro del malware.
• Adicionalmente te sugiero que, si haces uso de formularios de envío de correo, incluyas códigos captcha para evitar ataques de robots.
Cuando hayas realizado todas las tareas , envíanos un mensaje desde el apartado Contacto de tu Área de Cliente, y restableceremos el uso normal de los formularios de tu web. 
tercer correo:Hola:
En relación con tu consulta sobre el estado de dintelobras.es, te informamos de que el incidente detectado corresponde a una infección por malware / inyección de código malicioso en la aplicación alojada.
Desde el departamento de soporte no realizamos tareas de limpieza, desinfección ni recuperación de sitios web, ya que el mantenimiento y seguridad del contenido alojado corresponde exclusivamente al titular del servicio (o a su equipo técnico/desarrollador). Por tanto, deberás encargarte tú mismo de tomar las medidas oportunas para limpiar y asegurar el alojamiento.
Una vez hayas llevado a cabo dichas acciones, por favor respóndenos directamente al correo electrónico en el que te informamos de la detección del malware detallando las medidas tomadas. En cuanto recibamos tu respuesta, analizaremos de nuevo el sitio web y, si verificamos que todo está correcto, eliminaremos las restricciones impuestas.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент получил уведомления о вредоносном коде в wp-config.php и подозрительных файлах на хостинге сайта dintelobras.es на WordPress 6.2.2 с Elementor и несколькими плагинами. Нужно очистить сайт, закрыть уязвимости и обновить компоненты. Бюджет 250 USD.
analysis.reply: Entiendo que su web dintelobras.es (WordPress 6.2.2 con Elementor Pro y varios plugins) presenta código malicioso en wp-config.php y rutas sospechosas en el hosting. Mi plan: primero una copia de seguridad completa de archivos y base de datos; después revisar wp-config.php, .htaccess, los archivos PHP modificados recientemente y las tablas de la base de datos; eliminar el código inyectado; cambiar credenciales (BD, FTP, salts y contraseñas de administradores); actualizar el core, Elementor, Yoast y el resto de plugins; y terminar con un escaneo final. Calculo unos 2–3 días laborables para la limpieza y una verificación posterior. Puede ver ejemplos de mis proyectos con demos en vivo aquí: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/
analysis.reply_ru: Понимаю, что ваш сайт dintelobras.es (WordPress 6.2.2 с Elementor Pro и несколькими плагинами) содержит вредоносный код в wp-config.php и подозрительные пути на хостинге. Мой план: сначала полная резервная копия файлов и базы данных; затем проверка wp-config.php, .htaccess, недавно изменённых PHP-файлов и таблиц базы данных; удаление внедрённого кода; смена учётных данных (БД, FTP, salts и пароли администраторов); обновление ядра, Elementor, Yoast и остальных плагинов; финальное сканирование. Оцениваю очистку и последующую проверку в 2–3 рабочих дня. Примеры моих проектов с живыми демо можно посмотреть здесь: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Full-Stack Freelance Platform Development -- 2
description:
I need a modern, responsive web application built with React.js + TypeScript on the front end and Node.js + Express.js on the back end, tied to either PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB—whichever you prefer and can justify. 

The core idea is simple: a place “for earning” where people engage in freelancing focused on Web, app, and software development services. The platform must therefore support account creation, secure authentication, protected routes, and the usual CRUD flows for posting jobs, bidding, messaging, and managing profiles. Expect additional needs such as media or file uploads (e.g., portfolios, briefs) and solid error handling throughout.

What I expect from you 
• Component-based UI with clean state management and full mobile responsiveness 
• Well-structured REST APIs that expose every critical function 
• Role-based access so only authorised users hit protected areas 
• Complete environment setup with clear, developer-friendly documentation 
• One-click (or as close as possible) deployment to a mainstream host—Vercel, Render, AWS, or a comparable alternative

When you reply, please share: 
1. Links to at least two similar full-stack projects you’ve shipped 
2. Your estimated timeline with key milestones 
3. Your cost breakdown 

I’m ready to move forward as soon as we align on scope and schedule.

Нужны аутентификация, роли, CRUD для вакансий, откликов, сообщений и профилей, загрузка файлов, документация и деплой. Бюджет 1250 INR очень мал для такого объёма.

I'd start with the data model and auth, then build the job and bid flows, messaging, and uploads, and finish with docs and deployment to Render or Vercel. For live demos of my work, see https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: HTML5-листалка из PDF (150 стр., 279 МБ → 40–70 МБ)
description:
Задача: оптимизировать PDF (150 стр. + обложка, ~279 МБ) до 40–70 МБ и установить на сайт guitarworld-kaluga.ru как адаптивную HTML5-листалку (flipbook). 
Требования: 
Даунсэмплинг изображений до 120–150 DPI, удаление метаданных, без потери читаемости текста и качества фото. 
Реалистичное перелистывание, свайпы на смартфонах (iOS/Android). 
Lazy loading — книга не должна зависать на мобильных. 
Предпочтительно локальный плагин (DearFlip / dFlip / Real3D Flipbook), файл на нашем хостинге. 
Функционал: зум, полноэкранный режим, опционально скачивание PDF, работа оглавления (если есть гиперссылки). 
Без водяных знаков, без Flash, только HTML5/WebGL. 
Если облачный сервис — аккаунт на почту заказчика, без лимитов по времени/просмотрам. 
Порядок работ: 
Тест на 10 страницах — согласование качества и скорости. 
Обработка всего файла и установка на сайт. 
Проверка на ПК и смартфоне. 
Передача доступов, файлов плагина, инструкции по замене PDF. 
CMS: [указать или «стандартная, доступ к админке предоставлю»]. 
Обязательно ответьте в отклике: 
Какими инструментами оптимизируете PDF на 279 МБ? (конкретика) 
Какой плагин/сервис предложите и почему? 
Будет ли lazy loading? 
Пришлите 1–2 ссылки на работы с тяжёлыми PDF, быстро открывающимися на мобильном. 
Отклики без ответов на эти вопросы или с шаблонными фразами не рассматриваются.

title: Claude Chatbot for Product Queries
description:
I want to embed a Claude-powered chat widget on my e-commerce site so visitors can instantly ask about any item we sell and get accurate, conversational answers. The bot’s focus is product and delivery questions—no cart or payment handling—so its scope is tightly defined.

Here’s what I need it to do: 
• Load the product list I’ll supply (CSV or Google Sheet) and use it as the single source of truth. 
• From that data, return ingredients, materials, or technical specifications whenever a shopper asks. 
• When customers ask “When will this arrive?” or “Which shipping option is fastest?” the bot should surface delivery choices and ETA rules I’ll provide. 
• Run on Anthropic’s Claude via API, wrapped in either a lightweight Node.js or Python backend, and appear on the site as a floating chat bubble that matches our brand colors. 
• Update itself automatically whenever I replace the spreadsheet, without requiring code changes.

Acceptance criteria 
— Chat widget loads on my staging site and answers at least 95 % of test questions correctly using only the spreadsheet content. 
— Responses stay under Claude’s token limit and never reveal internal prompts or keys. 
— Clear README covering local setup, environment variables, and how to swap in a new product sheet.

If this sounds straightforward, let’s get it running.

title: Telegram FAQ Chatbot Development
description:
I want a Telegram-based chatbot that can step in as our first-line support and instantly answer the everyday questions customers send us. Once it is live, users should be able to type their query in any wording and receive a clear, accurate reply pulled from the knowledge base I will supply. If the bot cannot find a confident match, it should politely acknowledge the question and forward it to a human operator (or a designated Telegram group) so no request is left hanging.

Key expectations 
• Built on the official Telegram Bot API with clean, well-commented code. 
• AI-driven matching—OpenAI GPT, Dialogflow, Rasa, LangChain or a comparable NLP solution is fine as long as responses remain fast and costs are predictable. 
• Admin commands inside Telegram to refresh the FAQ set, turn maintenance mode on/off, and view simple usage stats. 
• Logs of unanswered questions captured to a CSV or Google Sheet so I can expand the knowledge base over time. 
• A short hand-off guide covering deployment (Docker, serverless, or plain VPS—whichever you choose), environment variables, and how to update the model or intents.

I will provide the curated FAQ content as soon as we start; you focus on wiring it to the AI engine, testing edge cases, and ensuring smooth handover to a human when necessary. A demo bot hosted on your infrastructure is fine during development; final delivery should include source code, install steps, and a quick screen-share walkthrough.

Otherwise the bot acknowledges the message and forwards it to your operator group. Unanswered questions go to a CSV or Google Sheet, and admin commands handle FAQ refresh, maintenance mode, and basic stats. Deployment will be Docker-based with a short setup guide. A first working version with your FAQ could be ready in about 2–3 weeks, followed by testing and handover. Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Bilingual Web App Performance Audit
description:

• A written audit covering performance metrics, architecture review, and the current i18n implementation 
• A prioritized, step-by-step roadmap of fixes and improvements, separating quick wins from deeper refactors 
• A follow-up call to discuss findings and next actions

You are free to use Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools, WebPageTest, profiling tools, or any preferred i18n debuggers—as long as the final report is clear and actionable. title: Senior Salesforce Developer (Freelancer)

title: Ручное тестирование Android-приложения по готовому чек-листу
description:
Ищем тестировщика, чтобы прогнать готовый smoke-тест Android-приложения родительского контроля.

О приложении. Одно приложение работает в двух ролях:
- телефон ребёнка: привязка к семье, фоновый сервис, блокировка приложений, расписания, дневные лимиты, геозоны;
- телефон родителя: консоль управления.

Обязательные требования:
- Минимум два своих Android-телефона, оба с Google Play:
-- один из них — Xiaomi, Redmi или POCO на HyperOS / MIUI;
-- второй — Android 13 или новее.

Будет плюсом:
- больше двух телефонов, особенно бюджетные Redmi A / Redmi C, realme, Tecno, Infinix;

Что сделать:
- Установить приложение из Google Play по ссылке на тестирование.
- Пройти чек-лист из 26 шагов (28 кейсов) в заданном порядке. По нашей оценке это 4,5–5 часов.
- Отметить в чек-листе статус каждого шага.
- Оформить найденные баги в файле по нашему шаблону: шаги, ожидаемый и фактический результат, скриншот или видео, логи adb logcat.
- Сдать архив: итоговый отчёт по шаблону, заполненный чек-лист, файл с багами, вложения.

Если всё устроит, планируем дальнейшее сотрудничество.

analysis.summary_ru: Ручное тестирование Android-приложения родительского контроля по готовому чек-листу из 26 шагов на собственных телефонах заказчика (Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO и Android 13+). Это QA-работа, а не разработка, и она не входит в услуги.

title: Ищем инженера-схемотехника/PCB-дизайнера
description:
О проекте: 
Есть рабочий прототип электронного прибора (схема и плата выполнены в EasyEDA, спецификация в виде базового списка с компонентами/ссылками). Прибор полностью рабочий, но текущий уровень документации любительский. Нам нужен профессиональный аудит и адаптация проекта под серийный монтаж (ориентируемся на экосистему jlcpcb/LCSC). 
Задачи для специалиста: 
Аудит схемы (Schematic Review): проверка цепей питания, добавление базовой защиты (от статики, переполюсовки, скачков напряжения). 
Нормализация BOM: перевод текущего списка компонентов на промышленные рельсы: подбор реальных MPN и кодов компонентов из каталога LCSC (с учетом доступности и аналогов). 
Корректировка топологии (PCB Layout): оптимизация разводки под требования DFM (Design for Manufacturing) автоматических линий монтажа (SMT/DIP). 
Подготовка пакета КД: генерация корректных Gerber-файлов, BOM и файла координат (CPL) для запуска на фабрике. 
Тестирование: рекомендации или добавление контрольных точек (Test Points) для базовой проверки плат. 
Что ждем от кандидата: 
Опыт успешной разработки и доводки плат до серийного производства. 
Уверенное владение EasyEDA (или готовность работать с этим форматом). 
Понимание правил трассировки, целостности сигналов и требований контрактных производств (преимущественно в Китае). 
Портфолио с примерами реальных серийных плат. 
См. приложенный файл.

title: Email, Calendar & Data Assistant

title: Online content writing Beginners level task
description:
I’m building a small library of easy-to-read health and lifestyle blog posts that explain everyday wellness concepts to people who are just starting to explore the topic. Your job is to research a sub-topic we agree on, organise the information so a newcomer can follow it, and deliver a polished article that could be published on a WordPress blog without major edits.

I’m looking for short pieces that teach, not sell. Think practical tips, clear definitions, and reassuring guidance rather than medical jargon or product plugs. If you already write about nutrition basics, simple fitness routines, stress management, sleep hygiene, or similar themes, you’ll feel right at home.

Deliverables 
• 1 original blog post (600–800 words) written in conversational English 
• SEO-friendly headline, sub-headings, and meta description 
• Sources or links to any studies or statistics you cite 
• A brief, one-sentence summary I can reuse as a social teaser

Acceptance criteria 
• Content passes Copyscape/Turnitin (100 % original) 
• Readability score suitable for a general audience (Flesch 60+ or equivalent) 
• No AI-generated text without clear human rewriting and fact-checking

If the first piece goes well, I’ll commission a small series on related beginner topics.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик ищет автора для написания статьи 600–800 слов о базовых принципах здорового образа жизни для блога на WordPress, с SEO-заголовком, источниками и проверкой фактов. Это копирайтинг, а не разработка.

title: QA Automation Engineer / SDET: Test Plan and Automated Suite for an AI Email-Processing API - 26/11/2026 09:27 EST
description:
QA Engineer: API Test Harness for an Email-to-Data Platform

We’re looking for an experienced QA engineer, not a developer, to design and run release testing for an AI-powered API. Our platform connects to a small business’s Gmail or Outlook inbox and turns its contents into structured records: contacts and their roles, document types and extracted fields, expense records, and AI-drafted emails. Because the output is a prediction, the core of this job is test design: building data where you know the right answer in advance, and scoring how close the system gets.

This role requires real QA or SDET experience. Proposals without testing experience won’t be considered.

Milestone 1 (fixed price): test plan and automated test suite

Write a test plan covering each area the system infers: company and user profile details, contacts, contact roles, document classification, document field extraction, expense records and drafted emails.
Create three test inboxes you control (two Gmail, one Outlook), seeded with fabricated small-business mail: invoices, receipts, statements, expense reports, customer and sales threads, contracts and forms, plus decoys the system should ignore. No real personal data.
Write the answer key before seeing the system’s output.
Automate the run: seed the inboxes repeatably, connect them through our standard OAuth consent flow, call our REST API, compare the JSON against the answer key, and produce a scored report.
Cover the edge cases: phone photos of receipts, link-only invoices, ZIP attachments, multiple currencies, a non-English document, duplicates and re-sends, corrections later in a thread, newsletter floods, consent revocation, and user corrections that must not be overwritten.

Milestone 1 is done when one command runs the full suite and produces a report with recall, field accuracy, invented items and duplicates per area, plus each failing case with expected vs actual. The code goes in a repo we own, with a README, and the first full round is completed.

Estimated effort: 60–85 hours. 

Ongoing (hourly): release testing

We have significant releases roughly every 2 weeks. Each release needs a fresh run, a short internal report with scores and regressions, and any failures reproduced and documented. Expect 10–15 hours per release. We may hire two testers.

Tools

Your choice: Python with pytest, Postman/Newman, TypeScript or similar. Experience with the Gmail API or Microsoft Graph is a plus. Full API docs and our testing spec are shared after an NDA is signed.

How to apply

Start your proposal with answers to these questions. Proposals that skip them won’t be reviewed.

1. Describe a QA or SDET role you’ve held and the kind of testing you owned.

2. The system extracts an invoice total and gets it right, but links the invoice to the wrong vendor. How would you score that?

3. An invoice is re-sent a week later with a corrected total. What should your answer key say?

4. How would you test that revoking access stops data from being served?

5. Your rough hour estimate for Milestone 1 and your hourly rate for release testing.

6. Link to a test plan, test suite or defect report you’ve written (redacted is fine). Shortlisted candidates do a paid 2-hour trial: writing test cases for one area from a short spec excerpt.

Skills: Software Testing, QA, Test Automation, Test Case Design, API Testing, Postman, Python, Test Plan Writing
Resume and references are also required.

NDA required to apply.
All test date, code and findings belong to us.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет QA/SDET-инженера для Milestone 1: тест-план и автоматизированный набор тестов (Python/pytest или аналог) для AI-API, который извлекает данные из почтовых ящиков Gmail и Outlook. Нужны сидирование тестовых ящиков, эталонные ответы, OAuth-подключение, запуск REST API, сравнение JSON и отчёт по метрикам. Оплата 50 CAD при оценке 60–85 часов выглядит несоответствующей, а от исполнителя требуется опыт QA, которого в моём профиле нет.
analysis.reply:
You need a harness that seeds three test inboxes, connects them through OAuth, calls your REST API, and scores the JSON against an answer key written in advance, with one command producing a per-area report. I'd build it in Python with pytest: a seeding script, fixture-based answer keys, a runner for the API calls, and a scorer that outputs recall, field accuracy, invented items and duplicates per area. My background is in automation scripts and API integrations rather than formal QA roles, so I'd bring that engineering side to the job and not claim prior testing history. Rough estimate: 2–3 weeks for Milestone 1 after I receive the spec and NDA. Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: iOS & Android Burrito App
description:
I need a full-featured mobile application, built once and released on both iOS and Android, for my burrito store that also sells ice cream and shakes. The core of the project is an intuitive ordering flow:

• Customers create an account or sign in, browse our complete food menu with photos and prices, and build their perfect burrito by choosing protein, size, toppings, and sauces. 
• They can add sides, shakes, or ice cream to the same cart, then choose either pickup or delivery. 
• Payment happens strictly in-app—credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or similar—so no cash handling at the counter. 
• For delivery, the app must route orders only to our own drivers; no third-party services will be involved. 
• At checkout, customers select a pickup or delivery time slot and immediately see their loyalty points balance and any rewards they can redeem.

From my side I need a web-based admin panel that receives orders in real time, lets staff update status (preparing, ready, out for delivery, completed), and manages menu items, pricing, promos, and loyalty rules. Push notifications should automatically confirm the order, alert customers when it’s ready or on the way, and announce new promotions.

I’m open to frameworks such as Flutter or React Native as long as the final build is smooth, fast, and accepted by both app stores. Clean, well-documented code and full hand-off of source, plus assistance through the publishing process, will be the key deliverables.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет кроссплатформенное мобильное приложение для заказа буррито, мороженого и коктейлей с оплатой в приложении, доставкой собственными курьерами, слотами времени, бонусной программой и push-уведомлениями. Также нужна веб-админка для приёма заказов в реальном времени, управления статусами, меню, акциями и правилами лояльности. Бюджет 750 CAD для такого объёма низкий.
analysis.reply:
You're looking for one cross-platform app for ordering burritos, ice cream and shakes, with pickup or delivery time slots, loyalty points and push notifications, plus a web admin panel where staff receive orders in real time and manage statuses, menu, promos and loyalty rules. I'd build the app in Flutter or React Native so one codebase ships to both stores, and make the admin panel a web app with live order updates. Using a modern stack with AI-assisted development, I'd expect the admin panel and core ordering flow to take about 3–4 weeks, followed by help with store submission. Since the budget is tight for this scope, I'd suggest agreeing on a must-have first release and moving the rest to a second phase.

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Which features must be in the first release? Do you already have the menu and loyalty rules defined, and do you have Apple Developer and Google Play accounts?

Yakov

analysis.summary_ru: Клиенту нужен Python-скрипт, который по историческим данным ETF считает, какая доля его акций на каждую торговую дату закрывается выше своей 20-дневной скользящей средней. Скрипт должен учитывать ребалансировки по CSV со снимками состава, обрабатывать пропуски данных и выгружать итоговый ряд процентов в CSV.
analysis.reply:
You want a script that, for each trading day, measures what share of an ETF's constituents trade above their own 20-day SMA, using adjusted closes and the holdings that were actually in the fund on that date, so rebalances are respected. I'd build it in Python with pandas: load the holdings snapshots, align each date to the constituents active then, pull adjusted prices, compute rolling averages, and count the percentage above the line while flagging missing tickers instead of silently dropping them. title: VisaNet Onboarding & API Setup
description:
I want to get my new Web POS platform live on Visa as quickly as possible. The first step is opening a fully functional VisaNet account, followed by activating Visa Cloud Connect so that I can route transactions securely through the cloud. Once credentials are issued, I also need ready-to-use payment APIs that plug straight into my existing web application.

Here’s exactly what I expect from you: 
• Guide me through the VisaNet application, including any compliance or KYC paperwork that Visa typically requests. 
• Coordinate the technical configuration in Visa Cloud Connect and obtain the production keys. 
• Deliver REST-based payment APIs (JSON over HTTPS) with clear documentation and a small sample app that runs a test sale from my Web POS. 
• Prove the flow end-to-end in the Visa sandbox, then walk me through the steps to switch to live processing.

The job is complete when the VisaNet account is approved, Cloud Connect is active, and I can successfully run a real authorization and capture from my Web POS dashboard.

Бюджет 250 USD мал для такого объёма, а одобрение аккаунта зависит от Visa и не контролируется разработчиком.
analysis.reply:
You want your Web POS live on Visa: account setup, Cloud Connect configuration, and REST payment APIs with a sample app that runs a sale end to end. I'd split this into two tracks. First, I'd build the API layer against the Visa sandbox: authorization, capture, refund and status endpoints in JSON over HTTPS, with clear documentation and a small demo app wired to your POS dashboard. Second, I'd help you assemble the KYC package and configure Cloud Connect once credentials are issued, then switch the keys to production. The API and sandbox part is roughly 1–2 weeks. Visa's approval timeline is outside my control, so I can commit to the technical deliverables but not to the date of account approval.

Two questions: do you already have an acquiring bank or processor partner, and which stack is your Web POS built on?

Live demos are here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Вы хотите запустить ваш веб-POS на Visa: настройка аккаунта, конфигурация Cloud Connect и REST-API для платежей с примером приложения, которое проводит продажу от начала до конца. Сначала построил бы слой API в сэндбоксе Visa: эндпоинты авторизации, захвата, возврата и проверки статуса в формате JSON поверх HTTPS, с понятной документацией и небольшим демо-приложением, подключённым к дашборду вашего POS. title: Website AI Chatbot Dev $1K/Wk
description:
I need a production-ready AI assistant embedded on my website that can hold natural conversations with visitors. Its core purpose is to answer questions in real time, drawing knowledge from my existing site content and internal documents. Beyond simple Q&A, it should act as a guided sales concierge—helping users compare or choose the right products and, when appropriate, capturing their contact details so my team can follow up.

Key deliverables I will review:

• Accurate, context-aware answers sourced from my documents or live page data. 
• Dynamic product or service recommendations based on the visitor’s needs. 
• Seamless lead capture that forwards name, email, and inquiry straight into our CRM or at least a structured webhook endpoint.

For the underlying tech, feel free to leverage OpenAI, LangChain, vector databases, RAG pipelines, or any stack you’re confident will scale securely. The front-end chat widget must load quickly on desktop and mobile and match our brand styling; a lightweight JavaScript snippet is ideal. Clear documentation, source code, and a brief hand-off session are part of the handover.

I’m budgeting US $1,000 per week and am prepared to move fast with milestones tied to a proof-of-concept, full integration, and final polish. If you’ve built site-embedded conversational agents before and can demonstrate reliable retrieval, personalization, and lead routing, let’s get started right away.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен AI-ассистент на сайте, который отвечает посетителям в реальном времени по контенту сайта и внутренним документам (RAG), рекомендует товары и передает контакты лидов в CRM или на webhook. В описании указан бюджет $1000 в неделю, но в поле бюджета стоит $25, поэтому бюджет нужно уточнить.
analysis.reply:
You need an on-site AI assistant that answers visitors in real time using your site pages and internal documents, recommends products, and passes qualified leads (name, email, inquiry) to your CRM. I would build it as a RAG pipeline: index your content into a vector store, retrieve the relevant passages for each question, and generate answers with an LLM under strict grounding rules so it does not make things up. The widget would be a lightweight script styled to your brand, and leads would go to your CRM or a webhook with retries. A proof of concept with retrieval and a basic widget would take about a week, followed by full integration with lead routing, then polish and handover docs. Which CRM are you using, and roughly how many pages and documents should be indexed?

title: Facebook Group Content Distribution Partner
description:
# Facebook Group Posting & Distribution Service — Using Your Own Accounts

## Project Overview

We are looking for a reliable, long-term Facebook group posting and content distribution service for our SaaS business, Captain Hook AI (https://captain-hook.ai/).

We already have an extensive database of more than 1,100 targeted Facebook groups, including research into group rules and promotional opportunities.

We are not looking for a social media manager, content creator, marketing strategist, or group researcher.

We are looking for an execution partner who can publish our content in specific Facebook groups using their own established Facebook accounts.

## What We Provide

- Exact Facebook group URLs.
- Ready-to-publish written content.
- Images, videos, and other creative assets.
- Website links.
- Posting dates and schedules.
- Posting frequency.
- Group-specific instructions.
- Different content variations for different communities.

## What You Are Responsible For

- Providing your own legitimate, established Facebook accounts or a team of authorized publishers.
- Joining the specific Facebook groups we provide when necessary and permitted.
- Publishing our content in the specified groups.
- Following our posting schedule and instructions.
- Respecting each group's rules and obtaining promotional permission where required.
- Managing posts that require moderator approval.
- Monitoring publication and approval status.
- Providing proof of publication and direct links to published posts.
- Reporting rejected, removed, or pending posts.

## Mandatory Requirements

**1. Your own Facebook accounts**

All publishing must be performed through accounts provided and operated by you or your authorized team.

We will not provide Facebook accounts, login credentials, access to our personal profiles, or access to our Facebook business accounts.

Our Facebook accounts must not be connected to your system.

**2. Our specific Facebook groups**

We decide exactly which Facebook groups we want to target.

Publishing exclusively in your existing network of groups is not sufficient. You must be able to join and publish in additional groups from our database, subject to their membership and promotional rules.

**3. Full control over content**

We provide the content, creative assets, links, and instructions.

Content must not be modified without our approval, except for necessary group-specific compliance adjustments agreed with us.

**4. Full control over scheduling**

We determine when content should be published, including:

- Specific dates.
- Specific time windows.
- Recurring posting schedules.
- Group-specific promotional days.
- Weekly posting campaigns.

**5. Scalable execution**

We are looking for a service capable of supporting ongoing campaigns across a large number of Facebook groups.

Preference will be given to established teams or agencies with multiple legitimate publishers and an organized operational workflow.

All publication must comply with Facebook policies and individual community rules. We do not accept fake engagement, impersonation, compromised accounts, or undisclosed endorsements.

## Preferred Workflow

Our preferred operational model is:

1. We submit the content and creative assets.
2. We select the exact Facebook groups.
3. We specify the posting schedule and instructions.
4. Your team handles the publication process.
5. Your team provides publication status and proof.
6. We submit additional campaigns on an ongoing basis.

A dedicated dashboard, campaign management platform, shared spreadsheet, or structured submission system is strongly preferred.

We want to manage campaigns efficiently without having to communicate manually about every individual post.

## Reporting Requirements

Each posting assignment must include:

- Facebook group name.
- Facebook group URL.
- Scheduled publication date.
- Actual publication date.
- Publishing profile or team member.
- Direct URL to the published post.
- Publication status: published, pending approval, rejected, removed, or not permitted.
- Screenshot when necessary.
- Reason for unsuccessful publication, if available.

## Pricing Structure

Please include your pricing for:

| Volume | Required quotation |
|---|---|
| 10 published posts | Pilot campaign |
| 50 published posts | Small campaign |
| 100 published posts | Standard campaign |
| 250 published posts | Large campaign |
| 500 published posts | Ongoing distribution |

We prefer transparent, volume-based pricing for successfully published posts, rather than hourly billing.

Any additional fees for joining groups, managing campaigns, or monitoring approvals must be clearly stated in advance.

## Initial Pilot

We will begin with a small paid pilot campaign across 10 selected Facebook groups.

The pilot will evaluate:

- Ability to publish in our selected groups.
- Independence from our Facebook accounts.
- Accuracy of execution.
- Schedule compliance.
- Publication success rate.
- Reporting quality.
- Communication efficiency.
- Cost per successfully published post.

Successful completion may lead to recurring campaigns across hundreds of Facebook groups.

## Application Requirements

Your proposal must include:

- A description of your existing Facebook posting service.
- Your publishing capacity per week and per month.
- The number of legitimate publishers available through your team.
- Your campaign management and reporting process.
- Examples of previous Facebook group distribution projects.
- Your pricing for the requested volumes.
- Your ability to work with client-provided group URLs and schedules.

## Important

This is a Facebook content distribution and execution project.

We are not purchasing followers, likes, comments, artificial engagement, or guaranteed traffic.

We are not looking for software that requires us to connect our own Facebook accounts.

We need a reliable publishing infrastructure operated by your team, with us controlling the content, target communities, and campaign schedules.

We are interested in a long-term business relationship with the right provider.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет исполнителя, который будет публиковать готовый контент его SaaS-продукта Captain Hook AI в Facebook-группах через собственные аккаунты исполнителя. Это ручная публикация и распространение контента, а не разработка, поэтому проект не подходит под услуги.

title: Multi-Channel Bulk Order Confirmations
description:
I need an automated workflow that fires a confirmation message every time a bulk order’s payment clears. The same core message must go out simultaneously via Email, Text message (SMS), and WhatsApp so customers receive identical information no matter which channel they prefer. 

The payload is simple but mandatory: just the payment status and the total amount for the order—nothing else is required at this stage. Messages must be dispatched strictly after the payment‐confirmed event, not at cart submission and not on a daily scheduler. 

My ecommerce platform already exposes webhooks for payment status, so you can catch that event and pipe it into your solution. I am open to common tools such as Twilio, WhatsApp Business API, SendGrid, or a lightweight Node/Python microservice—whatever you are fastest and most confident with—as long as it can be handed over in a way that I can maintain. 

Deliverables 
• Message templates for all three channels, formatted with dynamic placeholders for payment status and total amount 
• Integration code or middleware that listens for the payment‐confirmed webhook and triggers the outbound messages 
• Clear setup instructions and a quick test run proving all channels fire correctly 

Acceptance criteria: messages must arrive within 60 seconds of the payment confirmation event, show identical content across the three channels, and log a success or failure status for each dispatch.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен автоматический сервис, который после подтверждения оплаты массового заказа отправляет одно и то же сообщение (статус оплаты и сумма) по Email, SMS и WhatsApp одновременно, с логированием результата по каждому каналу. Срок доставки не более 60 секунд.
analysis.reply:
You need a webhook-triggered dispatcher: when a bulk order's payment clears, one shared message (payment status and total) goes out via Email, SMS and WhatsApp at the same time, with a success or failure log for each channel. I would build a small Node.js service that receives the payment-confirmed webhook, validates it, renders one template with the placeholders, and sends to SendGrid, Twilio (SMS) and the WhatsApp Business API in parallel. Every dispatch gets logged, so identical content and the 60-second delivery window are easy to verify in the test run. You would receive the code, the three templates, a short setup guide, and a recorded test run covering all channels. Estimated timeline: 5–7 days. Which ecommerce platform sends the webhook, and do you already have a WhatsApp Business API account with approved message templates?

See my live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен сервис, который запускается вебхуком: когда оплата массового заказа подтверждена, одно общее сообщение (статус оплаты и сумма) уходит по Email, SMS и WhatsApp одновременно, а по каждому каналу ведётся лог успеха или ошибки. Я бы написал небольшой сервис на Node.js: он принимает вебхук об подтверждённой оплате, проверяет его, формирует сообщение по одному шаблону с подстановками и параллельно отправляет через SendGrid, Twilio (SMS) и WhatsApp Business API. Каждая отправка логируется, поэтому одинаковое содержимое и окно доставки до 60 секунд легко проверить на тестовом запуске. Вы получите код, три шаблона, короткую инструкцию по настройке и демонстрацию тестового запуска по всем каналам. Оценочный срок: 5–7 дней. Какую платформу электронной коммерции вы используете для вебхуков и есть ли у вас аккаунт WhatsApp Business API с одобренными шаблонами сообщений?

Смотрите мои живые демо: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
questions: Какая платформа электронной коммерции отправляет вебхук о подтверждении оплаты?
Есть ли у вас аккаунт WhatsApp Business API и одобренные шаблоны сообщений?

title: Design and Build Wellness Tracker
description:
Title: iOS App Design and Native Swift Build for a Habit & Wellness Tracker (iPhone)

Description:

We’re looking for an experienced iOS designer-developer to design and build a native iPhone app from scratch. You’ll own the whole job, from information architecture through to high-fidelity UI and a working SwiftUI build ready for TestFlight.

About the app
It’s a personal habit and wellness tracker. Users set daily habits, log their progress in one tap, see streaks and weekly trends, and get gentle reminders. The app should feel calm, quick and premium, and it should be easy to use one-handed.

Scope of work

UX and information architecture

Map the user flows: onboarding, creating a habit, daily check-in, insights, settings
Build the sitemap and navigation model (tab bar vs. hub)
Make low-fidelity wireframes for every core screen

2. App design (UI)

High-fidelity designs in Figma for about 15–20 screens, in light and dark mode
A small design system: colour tokens, type scale, spacing, and reusable components
Micro-interactions for check-ins and streak milestones
An App Store icon and 5 App Store screenshots

3. Swift development

A native SwiftUI app targeting iOS 17+, built with MVVM
Local persistence with SwiftData, plus iCloud sync
Local notifications for reminders
Swift Charts for the weekly and monthly trends
A home screen widget (WidgetKit) showing today’s habits
Accessibility: Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels, and good contrast
Clean, documented code, delivered through a Git repository

Deliverables

Figma file (wireframes, UI, design system)
Xcode project and source code
TestFlight build
Short handover document

Milestones

IA and wireframes approved
UI design and design system approved
Core app build (habits, check-ins, persistence)
Insights, widget, notifications and polish
TestFlight delivery and bug fixes

Ideal freelancer

A portfolio that shows both iOS app design and shipped Swift/SwiftUI apps
Strong grounding in Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines
Clear communication and regular progress updates

When you bid, please include links to 2–3 iOS apps you’ve designed and built, and say which parts you did yourself.

Skills: App Design, Swift, User Interface / IA, iOS Development, Mobile App Development

Бюджет 37 500 INR. Задача в основном про дизайн и нативную iOS-разработку, а это не входит в услуги Якова.

title: Custom WordPress Package Builder
description:
DO NOT BID UNLESS YOU HAVE READ THE PROJECT IN FULL.

I need a fully-integrated package-builder added to my existing WordPress site (no e-commerce). The goal is to let visitors mix and match options, see one combined preview image update in real time, and watch the total price refresh alongside it. 

When they’re happy with their selection, the builder should: 
• display the final price and the live preview; 
• collect their name, email address and an open message field; 
• automatically email the full summary (options chosen, price, preview image) to both the customer and me. 

I’ll supply a screenshot plus private links to two competitor sites that already offer almost exactly what I want. Your job is to replicate the same smooth functionality while adapting the visuals, option list and pricing so we are clearly distinct. 

Key points to cover: 
• Works seamlessly inside WordPress—use a custom plugin, React/JS overlay, or another robust method you’re confident supporting. 
• Clean, responsive front-end that inherits my theme styling but can be tweaked easily in CSS. 
• Admin panel where I can add or edit option names, prices and the images used for the layered preview. 
• Instant image compositing—no page reloads. 
• Reliable email dispatch using WP Mail, SMTP or a service you recommend. 

Please quote your final, all-inclusive price; I’m not open to mid-project increases. Confirm you’ve built a similar dynamic configurator before and outline the tools or libraries you plan to use so I know the approach is solid.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет встроить в свой WordPress-сайт конфигуратор пакетов: посетители выбирают опции, превью и итоговая цена обновляются сразу, а после заявки сводка уходит на почту клиенту и заказчику. Нужны админка для опций, цен и слоёв изображений и надёжная отправка писем. Бюджет 250 GBP при таком объёме работ низкий, а задача копировать функциональность конкурентов требует уточнения.
analysis.reply: You need a configurator for your existing WordPress site: visitors pick options, a layered preview and the total price update instantly, then they submit their name, email and a message, and the summary (choices, price, preview image) goes to them and to you. I'd build it as a small custom plugin with a React or vanilla JS front end, a settings page in wp-admin for option names, prices and layer images, client-side canvas compositing so there are no page reloads, and email sent through wp_mail with an SMTP service for reliable delivery. The front end will inherit your theme styling, with its CSS in a separate file for easy tweaks. Since the visuals, option list and pricing will be yours rather than copied from the competitors, I'd suggest we define the option structure first. Estimated timeline is about 2–3 weeks for a first working version, followed by a round of fixes. Two questions: roughly how many option groups and layer images do you expect, and do you have a preferred email or SMTP service? You can see live demos at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/
analysis.reply_ru: Вам нужен конфигуратор для существующего сайта на WordPress: посетители выбирают опции, слоистое превью и итоговая цена обновляются мгновенно, затем они отправляют имя, email и сообщение, а сводка (выбор, цена, изображение превью) уходит им и вам. Фронтенд будет наследовать стили вашей темы, а CSS будет вынесен в отдельный файл для простой правки. Поскольку визуал, список опций и цены будут вашими, а не скопированными у конкурентов, предлагаю сначала согласовать структуру опций. title: Node.js Role-Based Access Control
description:
We are an established full-stack software development agency. We build websites, web apps, mobile apps, custom software, booking and management systems, and AI automation for clients worldwide. We are looking for a commission-based sales partner who can bring us real software projects and close them. This is a long-term revenue-share partnership, not a one-off gig.

WHAT YOU DO
- Find businesses that need software built (web, mobile, custom software, AI, automation).
- Open the conversation, learn what they need, and introduce us.
- Stay involved through to the close. You own the relationship and the deal.

WHAT WE DO
- All the technical work: requirement scoping, a free audit or demo for the prospect, the proposal, the pricing, and the full build and delivery.
- We join the technical and closing calls with you whenever you want us there.
- We hand you our portfolio, case studies and sales material, so you are never selling blind.

You do not write code. You do not manage the project. You bring the client and help close; we deliver the rest.

WHAT YOU EARN
- 20% of the first invoice we collect on any project you bring and close.
- Plus 10% of all recurring or retainer revenue from that client for 12 months.
- Uncapped, and paid on cash collected as the client pays us.

Our projects usually run from USD 1,000 to 15,000 and up, so one closed deal can pay you USD 200 to 3,000, and good clients come back for more work.

WHO THIS IS FOR
- People who already have business relationships, a network, or a genuine way to reach the decision-makers who buy software.
- Anyone comfortable selling B2B software or digital services.
- Agencies or individuals who want a reliable technical partner to deliver, so they can focus on selling.

NOT A FIT
- Cold-call lead lists, scraped contacts, or bulk email blasts. We do not pay for leads, intros, or meetings. We pay commission only on signed, paid contracts.
- Anyone who wants a fixed salary or hourly rate. This is pure commission with real upside.

HOW TO APPLY
In a few lines, tell us: which industries or regions you can sell into, how you plan to reach clients, and any B2B or software sales you have closed before. Keep it short and specific.
To show you actually read this, start your proposal with the word CLOSER.

We reply to serious applicants and can start right away.

title: WordPress Security Audit & Hardening
description:
My WordPress website needs a thorough security audit focused first on uncovering any signs of hacking or embedded malware. Once the current health of the site is confirmed, every weak point—whether it stems from core files, plugins, themes, server settings, or user-access rules—has to be fixed or hardened.

The workflow I have in mind is straightforward: 

1. Run an in-depth scan with industry-standard tools (for example, Wordfence, Sucuri CLI, WP-CLI commands, or comparable solutions) to detect malware, backdoors, and file-integrity issues. 
2. Document all findings in a concise report that shows severity, location, and recommended remediation for each item. 
3. Clean any malicious code or infections, close exploited vectors, and restore compromised files without losing legitimate content or functionality. 
4. Patch or replace outdated plugins/themes, adjust permissions, and apply security best practices—two-factor authentication, rate-limiting on logins, secure headers, database hardening, etc. 
5. Deliver a post-fix validation scan and a short checklist I can use to keep the site secure going forward.

Include in your proposal a detailed, step-by-step plan: which tools you prefer, how long each stage will take, and how you will make backups and verify the cleanup. If you have relevant case studies or can point to past WordPress recoveries, reference them briefly; they will help me gauge your approach.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиенту нужен полный аудит безопасности WordPress-сайта с поиском вредоносного кода и бэкдоров, затем очистка, устранение уязвимостей в ядре, плагинах, теме и на сервере, и итоговая проверка с чек-листом. Бюджет 250 USD для такого объёма ограничен.
analysis.reply:
You need a full WordPress security sweep: first find any malware or backdoors, then clean the infected files and harden the core, plugins, theme, server settings and user access. My plan starts with a full backup and snapshot before anything is changed. Then I'd run Wordfence and WP-CLI core checksum checks, plus a file-integrity diff against clean core files, and deliver a severity-ranked report. After you approve it, I'd remove the malicious code, update or replace outdated components, and set up 2FA, login rate limiting, security headers and database hardening. I'd finish with a validation scan and a short maintenance checklist. A realistic timeline for a standard install is 3–4 working days. For live demos of my work, see https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Two questions: do you have SSH or SFTP access and a recent backup? Is there WooCommerce or any membership functionality that must keep working during cleanup?

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Нужна полная проверка безопасности WordPress: сначала найти вредоносный код и бэкдоры, затем очистить заражённые файлы и укрепить ядро, плагины, тему, настройки сервера и доступ пользователей. Мой план начинается с полного бэкапа и снимка сайта до любых изменений. Далее я запущу Wordfence и проверки контрольных сумм ядра через WP-CLI, а также сравню целостность файлов с чистым ядром, и подготовлю отчёт с ранжированием по серьёзности. После вашего согласования я удалю вредоносный код, обновлю или заменю устаревшие компоненты и настрою 2FA, ограничение попыток входа, заголовки безопасности и защиту базы данных. Завершу итоговой проверкой и коротким чек-листом для поддержки. Реалистичный срок для стандартной установки — 3–4 рабочих дня. Живые демо моих работ: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Два вопроса: есть ли у вас доступ по SSH или SFTP и свежий бэкап? Нужно ли сохранить работу WooCommerce или других функций (например, членских разделов) во время очистки?

2. A data model or Excel template that clearly separates “Tasks & Deadlines,” “Customer/Supplier Issues,” and “Key Topics/Risks/Decisions.” 
3. Setup documentation so the daily job can be redeployed or adjusted by our internal IT team. 
4. One brief hand-over call or recorded demo showing the solution in action.

•Вывести товары из минуса: сверить остатки, при необходимости скорректировать цены и параметры поставок. 
•Посчитать маржинальность и точку безубыточности по заданным карточкам.

•Написать описания и заполнить характеристики этих 10 карточек так, чтобы они ранжировались выше в поиске Ozon. 
Результат к концу 7-го дня: итоговый отчёт с расчётами маржинальности и точки безубыточности, установленными ценами и таблицей семантики (ключевые слова и минус-слова), обновлённые карточки. 
Требования: 
•Понимание механики скидок и промо на Ozon. 
•Умение считать маржинальность и точку безубыточности. 
•Опыт работы с карточками в личном кабинете Ozon. 
•Понимание, как ключевые слова влияют на показы и конверсию. 
Будет плюсом: опыт работы с минус-словами, аккуратность в таблицах (Excel / Google Sheets). 
Как откликнуться: коротко напишите о своём опыте с Ozon и готовности стартовать в ближайшие 1–2 дня. В сообщении укажите: «Ozon: 7 дней».

title: AI Analysis: Top Revenue Products
description:

Once the numbers are reconciled, present the outcome in a single, easy-to-navigate spreadsheet. The sheet must rank each product or service by total income and include percentage contribution and grand totals. A cover tab with a short explanation of your method and any data gaps you found will help us follow your logic.

Feel free to use Python (pandas, NumPy), Power Query, or any other analytics tool you prefer—the only non-negotiable is that the final deliverable is the ranked spreadsheet (Excel or Google Sheets). Let me know your estimated turnaround time and any clarifying questions you have so we can get started right away.

I would handle this with a Python pipeline (pandas): load and validate each file, run a name-matching step that groups near-duplicate product names and flags uncertain matches for your review, reconcile totals against the accounting reports, and export an Excel workbook with a cover tab covering method and data gaps, plus a ranked sheet using formulas for shares and grand totals. Estimated turnaround is about 3–5 working days after I receive the files. Could you share sample rows from each source? title: Zero-Downtime WordPress Host Migration
description:
I need my entire WordPress environment moved to a new hosting account without visitors noticing the change. That means every file, database table, theme, plugin, upload, and setting must be cloned, spun up on the new server, fully tested, and then put live only when we both agree everything works. 

Email is part of the job: every mailbox, message, folder, contact and existing configuration has to come over intact so users open their clients on Monday and see the same inbox they closed on Friday. 

The current host uses cPanel and gives SSH access; the destination host offers the same. Feel free to use WP-CLI, phpMyAdmin, rsync, imapsync or any other tool you trust, as long as the result is reliable. 

Key steps I expect: 
• Create a temporary/staging copy on the new host and replicate the database and file system. 
• Copy all email accounts and historical mail, preserving folder structure and passwords. 
• Verify SSL, permalinks, forms, cron jobs and any third-party API calls. 
• Perform the final DNS cut-over during a low-traffic window once we agree the staging site passes tests. 

Deliverables accepted when: 
1. The site loads from the new server with no broken links, images or 404s. 
2. Admin login, plugin pages, and the front-end all function normally. 
3. All mailboxes authenticate and display historical mail on both webmail and IMAP clients. 
4. A brief hand-off note lists any credentials changed and points any residual DNS TTLs. 

If you have a proven process for zero-downtime WordPress migrations and email transfers, I’m ready to get this scheduled right away.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент просит перенести WordPress-сайт на новый хостинг без простоя вместе с почтовыми ящиками и историей писем (IMAP, webmail), с тестированием и переключением DNS. По сути это работа системного администрирования и миграции хостинга, а не разработка, поэтому под услуги Yakov она плохо подходит.

Currently, staff manually complete Word templates. I want to replace this with an electronic form where users enter the required information into designated fields, select relevant options and click Generate to produce a completed, editable Word document.

Required Features

1. Electronic Form

Text fields for name, address, employee number, position, school, dates and reference numbers.

Dropdown menus and checkboxes for notifications and assessment categories.

Optional fields for relevant demographic information.

Larger text boxes for Summary, Allegations, Witnesses, Intelligence, Physical Material and Conclusion/Recommendation.

Ability to add multiple witnesses and document reference numbers.

Conditional fields depending on selected options.

2. Word Document Generation

Generate an editable Microsoft Word document (.docx) from the completed form.

Automatically populate an existing professional Word template.

Maintain consistent headings, tables, fonts, margins and page numbering.

Automatically handle longer text without disrupting the formatting.

Allow users to save, edit and print the generated document.

3. Two Document Types

The application should generate either:

Full Assessment Report, including all sections.

Condensed Notification Record, for matters requiring only limited documentation.

The appropriate fields should appear depending on the document type selected.

Preferred Technology

Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate and Word templates, or an equivalent solution compatible with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

The application should be straightforward to maintain, with the ability to update fields or Word templates without requiring extensive programming knowledge.

Deliverables

Fully functioning prototype using fictional information.

User-friendly electronic form.

Two professionally formatted Word document outputs.

All editable source files and templates.

Basic instructions for modifying and maintaining the application.

Demonstration of the complete process from entering information to generating the document.

Important

This is initially a standalone proof of concept. No connection to government systems, confidential records or external databases is required.

The developer must use fictional test information only.

Please provide examples of similar projects, your recommended approach, anticipated completion time, any ongoing Microsoft licensing requirements and a fixed-price quote.
