title: Interactive Parent Company Brand Website
description:
Project Title
Need to build a parent Company Website which has Subsidiaries showcasing it’s Journey (US aesthetics but for Indian consumer) 

Project Description

We are looking to build a modern, premium website for a parent company that showcases its journey, vision, growth, and subsidiaries/brands under its umbrella.

The website should not feel like a traditional corporate website with static pages. We want the parent company's story and journey to be presented in a creative, interactive, and visually engaging way, allowing visitors to explore the company’s evolution and discover its subsidiaries through a well-designed digital experience.

We are particularly interested in freelancers who have experience creating modern corporate websites, interactive storytelling experiences, creative animations, and premium UI/UX designs.

Important: We will only consider freelancers who include relevant website references, templates, or design concepts in their proposal. Bids without design references or examples of the proposed direction will not be shortlisted.

Project Requirements

1. Parent Company Website
- Modern, premium, and professional website for a parent company.
- Clearly communicate the company's vision, story, identity, journey, and overall ecosystem.
- Strong visual presentation with a clean and intuitive user experience.
- The website should feel global, credible, and contemporary.

2. Interactive Company Journey
- Present the parent company's journey, milestones, evolution, and growth in an engaging way.
- The journey should be visually interactive rather than just a standard timeline.
- Explore creative ways to show milestones, growth, expansion, and important events.
- Smooth transitions, scroll-based storytelling, animations, or interactive elements can be proposed where appropriate.

3. Subsidiaries / Brands Ecosystem
- Showcase all subsidiaries, brands, or businesses associated with the parent company.
- Clearly communicate how each subsidiary is connected to the parent company.
- Visitors should be able to explore individual subsidiaries through interactive cards, sections, animations, or other creative layouts.
- Each subsidiary should have its own overview, description, identity, and relevant information.
- The overall experience should make the parent company and its ecosystem easy to understand.

4. UI/UX & Visual Design
- Premium, modern, and visually impactful design.
- Strong typography, layouts, imagery, and visual storytelling.
- Creative interactions without compromising usability.
- Smooth animations and transitions where they add value.
- Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- We do not want a generic corporate template with only colors and text changed.

5. Website Structure & Navigation
The website may include sections such as:

- Home
- About the Parent Company
- Company Journey / Timeline
- Subsidiaries / Brands
- Individual Subsidiary Details
- Our Vision / Mission
- Achievements / Milestones
- Contact / Inquiry
- Careers (if required)

The freelancer can suggest an improved sitemap and creative ways to structure the experience.

6. CMS / Admin Panel
- Easy-to-use backend to manage website content.
- Ability to add or edit subsidiaries and their information.
- Update company milestones and journey content.
- Change images, text, profiles, and other content without developer involvement.
- The admin panel should be simple for a non-technical team.

7. SEO & Performance
- SEO-friendly website structure.
- Editable meta titles, descriptions, and page content.
- Optimized performance and loading speed.
- Clean implementation and maintainable code.
- Analytics and future integrations should be possible.

What We Expect From the Freelancer

We are looking for someone who can contribute creatively, not just execute instructions.

The selected freelancer should:

- Understand the concept of a parent company and its brand ecosystem.
- Suggest a unique design direction and user journey.
- Have experience building interactive, storytelling-based websites.
- Be capable of handling UI/UX and development, or clearly explain their design and development process.
- Recommend the right technology stack based on the requirements.
- Deliver a responsive, polished, and production-ready website.

Mandatory Requirement for Applying

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. At least 2–3 relevant website references that match the style or experience you would propose for this project.
2. Links to websites you have personally designed or developed.
3. Your proposed approach for making the parent company journey and subsidiaries interactive.
4. Recommended technology stack.
5. Estimated timeline.
6. Fixed project quotation.

Proposals without relevant website references, template examples, or a clear design direction will not be considered.

Project Goal

We want to create a website that tells the story of a parent company, visually represents its growth and journey, and allows visitors to explore its subsidiaries in an engaging and memorable way.

We are looking for the right creative partner who can bring ideas to the table and build something beyond an ordinary corporate website.

title: Marketplace Project Tracking Enhancement
description:
I already run a freelancer marketplace and now want to sharpen the experience inside each project room. The priority is the workspace where clients and freelancers message, handle payments, and track work.  
My focus is on richer project-tracking tools—think task lists attached to every milestone, automatic progress updates that show at a glance, and friendly deadline reminders that prompt both sides before dates slip. These additions must fit cleanly into the current messaging thread and payment flow so users never feel they have left the platform.

You will analyse the existing codebase, propose the best way to slot these features in without disrupting live traffic, and then build, test, and deploy them. Clean UI, responsive behaviour, and clear database migrations are essential. 

Deliverables: 
• Technical plan outlining integration points and data models 
• Working task-list component with create, assign, reorder, and complete actions 
• Progress-update system that logs percent complete or checklist state automatically 
• Configurable deadline reminder service (email, in-app, or push) 
• Final hand-off docs: setup notes, commented code, and test coverage summary 

I’m happy to hear your thoughts on future layers such as real-time chat or enhanced escrow, but the above tracking tools are the immediate scope. Let me know how you would tackle this and any similar modules you have shipped before.

title: Student Reminder Telecalling Support Needed
description:
I have a list of enrolled students that must be contacted daily to keep them on track. Your job is to place short, friendly reminder calls that cover three points: 
• Upcoming classes or sessions they are scheduled to attend 
• Any pending document submission or application update they still owe us 
• A quick confirmation of their location so we know they can reach the venue on time 

After each call you will open our shared spreadsheet (Google Sheet) and log the outcome. For every student, I need two fields completed: 
1. Call status with a clear “confirmed / not confirmed / no answer” note 
2. If they are not attending or did not pick up, the reason they gave (or “no response” if silent)

Accuracy in the sheet is critical because we rely on it for daily attendance figures, so please double-check entries before you move to the next number. All numbers, sheet access, and a short calling script will be provided once we start. 

Fluency in clear spoken English (Hindi is a plus), a calm phone manner, and the ability to finish calls within the agreed slot each day will make this run smoothly. If you have experience with Google Sheets or similar CRMs, mention it when you reply so we can get you started right away.

title: Build Paid Voice Video Calling MVP
description:
Hiring: Freelance App Developer / Small Development Team

I'm looking for an experienced freelance developer or a small development team to build an Android-based Paid Voice & Video Calling Platform, similar to a host-based voice/video calling application.

I have a reference document outlining the required platform and features. The goal is to develop a functional MVP with all essential features while keeping the development process as cost-effective as possible.

1. Customer Android App

User registration and login

User profiles

Host listing and profile viewing

Online/offline host availability

Wallet balance and recharge

Paid voice and video calling

Call history and transaction history

Ratings and reporting system

2. Host App / Interface

Host login with assigned credentials

Host profile management

Online/offline/busy status

Incoming voice/video call notifications

Accept/reject calls

Call history

Earnings and wallet details

3. Admin Web Dashboard

Customer and host management

Host verification and approval

Wallet and transaction management

Call rate and commission management

Host payout management

Reports and analytics

Complaints and user management

4. Preferred Technology Stack

Mobile App: Flutter

Backend: ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET)

Database: MongoDB

Admin Dashboard: React.js

Voice/Video Calling: Agora SDK or LiveKit

Real-time Communication: SignalR

Push Notifications: Firebase FCM

Payment Gateway: Razorpay

Cloud Hosting: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Developers can also suggest alternative technologies if they can deliver the same functionality with lower development and maintenance costs.

5. Important Requirements

Android application only for the initial phase.

Focus on essential MVP features.

Cost-effective development approach.

Clean, simple and user-friendly UI.

Secure wallet and payment processing.

Proper server-side call duration and billing calculation.

Scalable backend architecture.

Complete source code and ownership handover.

Deployment and basic technical documentation.

6. What I'm Looking For

Please share the following details:

Your previous app development experience.

Portfolio or links to previously developed applications.

Experience with Flutter, .NET and voice/video calling SDKs.

Your suggested technology stack.

Your lowest possible quotation with a feature-wise cost breakdown.

Estimated development timeline.

Post-development support details.

Preference: Individual freelancers or small development teams who can deliver a reliable, fully functional product with minimum development and maintenance costs.

Please apply only if you have relevant experience in mobile app development and real-time voice/video calling integration.

title: Mosquito-proof Cooler Retrofit
description:
I need a retrofit extension for my portable evaporative air cooler to prevent mosquito breeding. The solution should stop mosquitoes from entering the water tank.

Current entry points:
- Water-filling opening
- Air vents or cooling pads

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience with HVAC or cooler modifications
- Knowledge of mosquito prevention methods
- Problem-solving skills to seal entry points effectively
The design logic

There are two ways to stop the mosquito. Keep her out of the tank, and make the tank useless if she gets in anyway. Then go one step further and use the cooler to remove mosquitoes from the area. Each part covers one of these jobs, and all of them follow your five rules: block egg-laying, fit any cooler as a retrofit, keep cooling the same, use no chemicals, and keep refilling easy.

1. Seal tray

Why: In a desert cooler, the tank is an open box under the pads. Mosquitoes fly in through the gaps around the pads and land on the wet walls. To keep them out, you have to close the tank without blocking the airflow, and the airflow is in the pad area, not the tank. So the seal goes between the two.

Design:

It's a flat panel that rests on the tank rim, with a soft foam strip around the edge. An adult Aedes is only a few millimetres long, so even a small gap lets her in. The foam presses into uneven rims and fills those gaps.
It slopes slightly toward the U-bend. This matters a lot. If water sat in puddles on the tray, the tray itself would become a new place to breed. With the slope, every drop drains away.
It's cut-to-fit, in 2–3 standard sizes, which is what makes it work across cooler brands.
For the prototype it's acrylic, because a laser cutter makes it quick and accurate. A real product would be injection-moulded polypropylene, which is cheap, survives sunlight and won't crack.

Trade-off: it needs about 1–1.5 cm of space between the tank rim and the pad frame. Some very compact coolers may not have that room.

2. U-bend drain

Why: The water that drips off the pads has to get back into the tank, so the tank can never be fully closed. The question is how to let water through without letting insects through. Sinks solved this a long time ago with a trap: a bend that always holds some water. Water can flow through it, but air and insects can't get past the water.

Design:

It's made from ½" PVC elbows, which are cheap and available at any hardware shop, and wide enough for the amount of water dripping off the pads.
The water in the bend should be 3–4 cm deep, so a mosquito can't simply cross it.
The outlet points straight down into the tank, so the drip doesn't splash onto the tank walls and wet them.

Trade-off: if the cooler sits switched off for weeks, the water in the bend can evaporate and leave the path open. In your testing, measure how long the water stays in the bend. For the final version, a small floating ball valve could close it automatically.

3. Refill funnel with flap

Why: People refill coolers with a bucket every day. If refilling gets harder, they'll take the lid off and leave it off, and the whole design fails. So the opening has to be easy to use and still close by itself.

Design:

A rubber flap hangs under the funnel. The weight of the water pushes it open, and it falls shut by gravity when you stop pouring. No springs, and nothing for the user to remember.
Why not just a mesh over the opening? A wet mesh holds a thin film of water, which is exactly the kind of damp surface Aedes like to lay eggs on. A flap has no such surface.
The funnel's sides are steep, so no water is left sitting in it.

Trade-off: dirt can stop the flap from closing fully. It needs a quick wipe now and then.

4. Pipe grommet

Why: The pump pipe has to pass through the tray. Any loose hole there would be a way in.

Design: a rubber grommet, which is a ring with a cut in it. It grips the pipe tightly and still fits slightly different pipe sizes.

5. Hex float tiles

Why: This is the backup layer. If a mosquito gets in through a gap or while the lid is open, she still shouldn't be able to breed. Aedes need two things: a wet edge just above the water to lay eggs on, and a calm, open surface where the larvae can breathe. Covering the water takes away both.

Design:

Why hexagons rather than balls? Round balls always leave gaps between them. Hexagons fit together edge to edge, the same way honeycomb does, so they cover far more of the surface.
They float. As water evaporates or gets refilled, the cover rises and falls with it, so the waterline is always covered. A fixed cover can't do this.
They're about 6 cm across: big enough to stay away from the pump, and small enough to pour in through the funnel.
To make them float, print them in PETG with closed top and bottom layers so air stays trapped inside. Test a few in a bucket before printing the full set.
Bonus: covering the water reduces evaporation from the tank, so it needs refilling less often. Cooling isn't affected, because the cooling comes from the pads, not the tank.

Trade-off: water splashing off the drain can push tiles out of place. Pointing the U-bend outlet straight down keeps the surface calm.

6. Pump mesh basket

Why: If a tile gets sucked onto the pump's intake, the pump runs without water and the cooling stops.

Design: a coarse steel or nylon mesh around the pump. The holes are much smaller than a tile but large enough that water flows freely. It also keeps leaves and dust out of the pump.

7. Decoy trap cup

Why: Sealing the tank only stops the cooler from becoming a breeding site. The mosquito still lays her eggs somewhere else. The trap gives her a place to lay them that kills her offspring, so every cooler with the kit helps reduce the mosquito population nearby. This is what makes the project more than just "a lid".

Design:

Dark felt strip at the waterline: Aedes prefer dark, rough, damp surfaces for laying eggs, so the cup is made to be more attractive than anywhere else around.
Mesh funnel inside: larvae swim down through the funnel. When they turn into adults, they can't find the narrow opening to get back up, so they drown.
Fed by a drip line from the pump: the water keeps getting topped up and stays fresh, so the cup never dries out and doesn't need the user to fill it.
An overflow hole covered with fine mesh: extra water can drain out, but larvae can't escape.
It's on the outside of the cooler: the cup stays visible and easy to remove, and nothing in it is near the tank.

Trade-off: if the mesh tears, the trap becomes a breeding site itself. The fix is to empty and check the cup once a week. It's a ten-second job and much easier than cleaning the whole tank.

How it all fits the brief
Prevent egg-laying: the tray, U-bend and flap keep mosquitoes out, and the tiles make the water useless to them if they do get in.
Retrofit: the tray is cut-to-fit with a foam edge, the U-bend and funnel are standard parts, and the tiles fit any tank.
Cooling preserved: none of the parts touch the pads, the fan or the airflow.
No chemicals: everything works physically, by using mosquito behaviour against them.
Easy to use: you refill the same way as before, and the only upkeep is emptying the trap cup once a week.

title: PEB STAAD.Pro Model Validation Expert
description:
# Freelance PEB Structural Design Engineer – STAAD.Pro Model Validation

**About NirmanIQ**

NirmanIQ is building an AI-powered engineering automation platform for the construction industry. We are developing automation workflows for Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB), covering parametric inputs, structural model generation, STAAD.Pro analysis and design optimisation, and proposal-stage engineering outputs.

**What we need**

We are looking for an experienced freelance PEB structural engineer to help validate generated engineering models and outputs, identify gaps, and provide practical guidance to improve our automation workflows.

**Scope of work**
- Review STAAD.Pro models generated by our platform against approved project baselines.
- Validate structural modelling assumptions, loading, load combinations, bracing and member design.
- Review steel design outputs with reference to IS 800 and relevant applicable design standards.
- Identify discrepancies and explain the engineering reasons behind them.
- Recommend corrections to structural modelling and automation logic.
- Provide technical guidance to our development team when engineering questions arise.

**Required experience**
- 8+ years of hands-on PEB / industrial steel structure design experience.
- Strong working knowledge of STAAD.Pro.
- Practical experience with IS 800 steel design.
- Experience with portal frames, bracing systems, purlins, girts and industrial buildings.
- Ability to independently review engineering outputs and explain design decisions.

**Engagement model**
- Freelance, assignment-based engagement.
- Initial paid evaluation assignment using one completed PEB project.
- Potential for continued technical consulting and validation assignments based on mutual fit.

**To apply, please share**
- Relevant PEB project experience.
- Your experience with STAAD.Pro and IS 800.
- Types of structures you have designed.
- Your expected hourly or project-based rate.

title: UE5 1v1 Fighter Teaser Prototype

1. Playable Windows build and the complete UE 5 project 
2. Short capture sequence (or instructions) showing off beast transformations for the trailer 
3. Basic documentation on controls, blueprints/C++ modules, and how to swap assets if we decide to move beyond mannequins

Acceptance criteria 
– Transformations fire only when the meter is full and always complete without clipping 
– Visual effects layer cleanly across Epic’s base mannequin materials 
– 60 fps on a mid-range PC at 1080p 
– No critical crashes in a five-round test loop

When you reply, please link any UE 5 action or fighting prototypes you’ve built and confirm you are comfortable working entirely with mannequins for this teaser phase.

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to develop a professional, secure and mobile-responsive E-commerce website for our organic and traditional food products brand, MAGITHI.

**Project Budget:** ₹8,000 Maximum (Fixed Budget)

### 1. Technology Requirements
- Frontend: React.js / Next.js
- Backend: Next.js API / Node.js
- Database: MySQL (Preferred) / SQL Server (Acceptable)

### 2. Website Design & UI/UX
- Premium, clean and professional organic brand design.
- White/Cream background with Forest Green and Black theme.

- Professional homepage, banners, product categories and product suggestions.
- Responsive product listing and detailed product pages.

### 3. Product & Inventory Management
- Initially 20 products, expandable to 50+.
- Product categories and multiple images.
- Pack-size variations (50g, 100g, 250g, 500g, 1kg).
- Individual pricing, SKU and stock management.
- Product descriptions, ingredients and details.
- Discounted pricing and stock availability.

### 4. Customer Features
- Registration, login and guest checkout.
- Customer profile and delivery addresses.
- Shopping cart and Buy Now.
- Order history and order tracking.

### 5. Online Payment Integration
- UPI, Debit/Credit Cards and Net Banking.
- Razorpay / Cashfree or suitable Indian payment gateway.
- Secure server-side payment verification.
- Payment confirmation and failure handling.
- **ONLINE PAYMENT ONLY – COD NOT AVAILABLE.**

### 6. Shipping & Free Shipping
- India-wide shipping support.
- Configurable shipping charges.
- Initial Free Shipping offer: Orders above ₹800.
- Green FREE SHIPPING badges on eligible product pages.
- Dynamic cart message: "Add ₹XXX more to unlock FREE SHIPPING!"
- Automatic shipping charge calculation.
- Free Shipping message and ₹0 shipping at checkout.
- Admin control to manually change shipping charges and free-shipping threshold.
- PIN code checking only if required.

### 7. Admin Dashboard
- Product, category and inventory management.
- Order and customer management.
- Payment status and transaction details.
- Shipping charge and Free Shipping configuration.
- Coupons and promotional offers.
- Sales and inventory reports.

### 8. Other Important Features
- WhatsApp customer support and order notifications.
- Email notifications where feasible.
- Order receipts and PDF invoices.
- Future GST compatibility.
- SEO-friendly website.
- Google Analytics, Search Console and Meta Pixel.
- SSL security, database backup and customer data protection.

### 9. Source Code & Ownership
- Complete frontend and backend source code.
- Complete database and backup.
- Deployment on our hosting.
- Admin credentials and documentation.
- Post-launch bug-fix support.
- Complete project ownership and handover.

### 10. Budget & Important Conditions

Maximum development budget: **₹8,000 Fixed.**

- Prefer MySQL and open-source technologies to minimize recurring costs.
- Domain and hosting will be provided by us.
- No unnecessary paid plugins or subscriptions.
- All additional and recurring costs must be disclosed before development.
- No extra development charges without our prior written approval.

Please download and carefully review the attached PDF before submitting your quotation.

Your proposal must clearly mention:
1. Which features are fully included.
2. Which features are partially included or excluded.
3. Any additional or recurring costs.
4. Estimated delivery time and milestones.
5. Post-launch support period.
6. Confirmation that complete source code and database will be handed over.

**Important:** All requirements in the attached PDF must be reviewed and agreed upon before development begins. Features already specified in the PDF must not later be treated as additional scope. Any extra charges or scope changes require our written approval before implementation.

We are looking for a reliable developer who can deliver quality work with transparent pricing and proper communication.

**MAGITHI – Grow Naturally Everyday.**

title: Website QA & Workflow Assistant
description:
I handle all client communication for the websites I build, but I need a reliable assistant working quietly in the background to keep each project running smoothly.

Your first priority will be to open every draft site on both desktop and mobile and give it a thorough pre-client check. I want absolute confidence that links, forms, and other basic functions behave exactly as expected. Buttons, menus, and page-to-page links must be clicked, tapped, and tested until nothing breaks.

Beyond that immediate QA pass, you will:

• Turn my meeting notes and client feedback into clear, actionable tasks for the designer, writer, and developer. 
• Keep logos, brand guidelines, images, and copy in a tidy, version-controlled folder structure so the team can always grab the latest approved file. 
• Track deadlines and revision rounds, flagging any missing assets, blockers, or unanswered questions so I can raise them with the client quickly. 
• Send me concise status snapshots that highlight what’s ready for review and where I need to step in.

Deliverables for each website:

1. A QA report confirming every link, form, button, menu, and critical function passes on both desktop and mobile. 
2. A task board (Trello, Asana, or similar) populated with next-step items for the team. 
3. A neatly organized asset folder, clearly labeled and dated. 
4. A one-page weekly summary outlining progress, blockers, and upcoming deadlines.

If you enjoy methodically spotting issues before clients ever see them and can keep a fast-moving project organized from first mock-up to final launch, we’ll work well together.

title: Build Autonomous Kalshi Trading Bot
description:
Project Title: Fully Automated Kalshi Trading Bot Development

I am looking for an experienced Python developer or quantitative trading engineer to develop a fully autonomous, real-time trading bot integrated with Kalshi's live trading API.

The objective is to create a reliable system that continuously monitors prediction markets, identifies qualifying trading opportunities based on predefined criteria, and automatically executes real-money trades without manual intervention.

Core Functional Requirements

- Live API Integration: Connect directly to Kalshi's production environment for real-time market data, account balances, order execution, and portfolio management.
- Automated Market Scanning: Continuously monitor available markets and identify outcomes with a market-implied probability of 70% or higher.
- Automatic Trade Execution: Execute real-money trades without requiring manual authorization.
- Position Sizing: Allocate up to $100 per qualifying trade, with configurable allocation amounts.
- Concurrent Trading: Support multiple active positions simultaneously, subject to available capital.
- Duplicate Prevention: Prevent unintended duplicate trades on the same event.
- Capital Management: Automatically verify available funds before executing trades.
- Risk Management: Implement configurable daily loss limits, maximum capital exposure, and automatic trading suspension thresholds.
- Settlement Tracking: Automatically identify settled markets and calculate net profits and losses, including transaction fees.
- Profit Management: Track daily, weekly, monthly, and cumulative profitability.
- SMS Notifications: Provide notifications for executed trades, settlements, profits, losses, and system failures.
- Dashboard: Provide visibility into account balances, active positions, trading history, performance metrics, and system status.
- Emergency Shutdown: Include a manual kill switch that immediately suspends trading.
- Continuous Operation: Support uninterrupted 24/7 operation with automatic recovery from API failures, connectivity issues, and system restarts.
- Configurable Parameters: Allow trading criteria, allocation amounts, risk limits, and scanning frequency to be modified without rewriting the source code.

Required Developer Experience

- Advanced Python development
- Kalshi API or comparable prediction-market API integration
- Automated trading systems
- REST APIs and WebSockets
- Real-time data processing
- Financial order management systems
- Database management
- Cloud deployment and cybersecurity
- Backtesting and performance analysis

Existing Infrastructure

I already have a Python environment established, successful Kalshi demo API authentication, market-scanning functionality, historical data collection, and preliminary simulation and backtesting scripts. The developer should evaluate the existing infrastructure and determine what can be retained or improved.

Expected Deliverables

- Fully functional automated trading bot
- Successful demo and live-environment validation
- Trading and performance dashboard
- Complete source code and ownership
- Installation and configuration documentation
- Deployment instructions
- Error-handling and recovery mechanisms
- Secure API credential management

The final product must be a production-ready, independently operating trading system—not simply a market scanner, alert system, or paper-trading simulator. Manual intervention should only be necessary when modifying trading parameters, performing maintenance, or suspending operations.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет автономного Python-бота для работы 24/7 с боевым API Kalshi: поиск рынков с вероятностью от 70%, автоматические сделки до $100, лимиты риска, учёт расчётов и комиссий, SMS-уведомления, дашборд и аварийное отключение. Бюджет $250 очень мал для такого объёма работ.

title: Urgent Website Proxy Error Fix
description:
My site still loads, but every attempt to navigate triggers a proxy-block error instead of the normal pages. I need someone to jump on a live session with me, diagnose the root cause, clear the block, and leave the site fully functional before we wrap up the call.

Here’s what will make the engagement a success:

• During our scheduled appointment you pinpoint the reason the proxy block appears (server rules, firewall, DNS, mis-configured plugin, or anything similar) and remove it. 
• All public pages must open normally—no more error screens. 
• You recommend and, if practical, implement the best long-term proxy or alternative solution so the problem doesn’t return. 
• A brief note of the changes you made is handed over at the end.

I’ll provide hosting panel and CMS credentials on the call. Let me know your earliest availability for a screen-share and how long you expect the fix to take.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиенту нужно срочно устранить ошибку прокси-блокировки, которая появляется при переходе между страницами сайта, хотя сам сайт открывается. Требуется живая сессия, диагностика причины, исправление и краткая справка об изменениях; бюджет небольшой (30 USD).
analysis.reply:
From your description, the homepage loads but every navigation is replaced by a proxy-block error. That usually comes from a redirect or rewrite rule, a firewall/WAF rule, a CDN or caching layer, or a plugin intercepting requests. I'd start by tracing the request chain on a few failing URLs and checking server and CMS logs, so we find the actual source instead of guessing. Once it's identified, I'd remove the block, check all public pages, and give you a short change note. For a lasting fix, I'd also suggest a proper rule set that survives updates. The screen-share can fit into a 60–90 minute window if access goes smoothly. Which hosting provider and CMS do you use, and did the error start after a specific change? Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

Судя по описанию, главная страница загружается, но при каждом переходе вместо нужной страницы появляется ошибка прокси-блокировки. title: Build Entrepreneur Social Funding Platform
description:
Project Description: CrazyNaters Entrepreneur Network

Project Overview

Create a social networking platform designed for entrepreneurs, startup founders, investors, and people who want to build businesses together.

The website will allow users to connect with entrepreneurs in their industries, find business partners, create startups, collaborate on ideas, raise money through crowdsourcing, and potentially become partial owners of businesses they help fund.

The goal is to bring people together to combine their skills, ideas, resources, and investments to build businesses as a community.

The platform should integrate with the existing CrazyNaters websites:

- https://crazynaters.com
- https://chat.crazynaters.com

CrazyNaters will provide social networking and real-time communication, while the new platform focuses on entrepreneurship, startup creation, business collaboration, crowdfunding, and ownership opportunities.

1. User Registration and Profiles

Build a complete account system with:

- User registration, sign-in, and secure authentication.
- Personal profiles with pictures, biographies, and interests.
- Professional backgrounds, skills, experience, and industries.
- Business interests and areas of expertise.
- Location and networking preferences.
- Activity feeds and profile updates.
- Ability to showcase businesses, projects, and accomplishments.
- Privacy and account settings.

Users should be able to create professional profiles and connect with people who have complementary skills and business interests.

2. Social Networking and Friends

The website should function like a professional social network for entrepreneurs.

Features should include:

- Add friends and send connection requests.
- Follow entrepreneurs and businesses.
- Private messaging and group conversations.
- Posts, comments, likes, and sharing.
- Activity feeds and business announcements.
- Discover entrepreneurs by industry, skills, and location.
- Find potential business partners and co-founders.

3. Entrepreneur Networks

Allow users to join specialized networks based on industries and interests, including technology, software, artificial intelligence, gaming, real estate, retail, healthcare, marketing, manufacturing, finance, food, and renewable energy.

Each network should have discussion areas, member directories, business opportunities, collaboration tools, and community activity.

Users should also be able to create their own networks and invite others.

4. Create a Business or Startup

Registered users should be able to create business profiles directly on the website.

Each business profile should include:

- Business name, logo, and description.
- Industry and business category.
- Founders and team members.
- Business mission and goals.
- Products and services.
- Business development progress.
- Funding goals and financial information.
- Business updates and announcements.
- Ownership information.
- Discussion and collaboration areas.
- Crowdfunding and investment opportunities.

Business creators should be able to invite entrepreneurs to join their teams and help develop their companies. A business can begin with one founder and grow into a team of contributors, partners, and investors.

5. Crowdsourcing and Business Funding

Allow businesses to raise funds from the community through dedicated funding campaigns.

Business owners should be able to explain:

- What their business does and what they want to build.
- How much funding they need.
- How the money will be used.
- Business goals and milestones.
- What contributors or investors may receive.
- Whether the opportunity involves donations, rewards, or equity.

Users should be able to browse businesses seeking funding, review opportunities, and participate where eligible.

Support community contributions, reward-based crowdfunding, business sponsorships, and legally permitted equity investments.

6. Business Ownership and Equity Investment

Allow eligible users to invest in businesses and potentially become partial owners.

For example, a startup could offer a percentage of its ownership in exchange for funding.

The platform should support:

- Founders establishing business ownership structures.
- Businesses defining the percentage of equity available.
- Investors reviewing business opportunities and offering details.
- Eligible investors purchasing available ownership interests.
- Recording ownership percentages and allocations.
- Investor dashboards showing documented ownership.
- Business financial and operational updates.
- Ownership and transaction history.

For example, a startup might offer 20% of its equity for a specified funding amount. Multiple eligible investors could participate, with each person's ownership recorded according to the offering terms.

Clearly distinguish donations, rewards, and actual equity ownership. Making a contribution must not automatically make someone an owner.

7. Owner Participation and Business Guidance

People with ownership or other defined participation rights should have ways to help guide the businesses they support.

Business owner and stakeholder areas should include:

- Company updates and announcements.
- Business discussions.
- Suggestions and recommendations.
- Product and service feedback.
- Scheduled meetings.
- Business milestone tracking.
- Professional guidance and collaboration.
- Voting on company matters when ownership or governance agreements provide voting rights.
- Opportunities to participate in strategic decisions.

The goal is to create a collaborative business environment where founders, investors, and participating owners work together.

Decision-making authority must follow each company's ownership agreements and governance structure. Not every investor automatically has control over daily operations.

8. Entrepreneur Collaboration and Startup Teams

Help users find people who want to start or grow businesses together.

Users should be able to post opportunities such as:

- Looking for a co-founder or business partner.
- Seeking developers, designers, or marketing specialists.
- Looking for investors or manufacturing partners.
- Building a new product.
- Starting a company in a specific industry.

Entrepreneurs should be able to create teams, assign roles, share project information, and collaborate on business development.

9. CrazyNaters Chat Integration

Integrate the platform with:

- https://crazynaters.com
- https://chat.crazynaters.com

Use the existing CrazyNaters chat platform for real-time communication between entrepreneurs, founders, investors, and business teams.

Features should include:

- Secure account integration or single sign-on where possible.
- Private messaging and group chats.
- Business-specific chat rooms.
- Private investor and stakeholder rooms.
- Startup team communication.
- Public entrepreneur networking rooms.
- Voice chat.
- Community discussions.
- Notifications and announcements.

Each business should have its own communication space for founders, team members, and eligible stakeholders. Both platforms should feel like one connected community.

10. Business and Administration Dashboards

Each business should have a dashboard where authorized users can manage:

- Business profiles and teams.
- Funding campaigns.
- Investment and ownership records.
- Stakeholder communications.
- Business announcements and progress.
- Document storage and meeting scheduling.
- Governance and voting tools where applicable.
- Financial reports and transaction history.

A separate administrator dashboard should manage users, businesses, networks, reports, moderation, and platform activity.

11. Payments, Investments, and Security

Support secure payments and funding transactions, including user payments, crowdfunding contributions, business funding campaigns, and investment transactions where legally permitted.

Maintain transaction histories, receipts, ownership records, and funding confirmations.

Because equity investment involves financial and securities regulations, the platform must include appropriate legal and compliance requirements. These may include identity verification, investor eligibility checks, offering disclosures, investment limits, escrow arrangements, and working with properly registered funding portals or broker-dealers where required.

Do not advertise or process equity sales until the offering and transaction structure are legally approved for the applicable jurisdiction.

Security should include encrypted communications, secure authentication, access controls, audit logs, and protection of sensitive business and financial information.

12. Overall Vision

Build a social network where entrepreneurs can do much more than simply connect and communicate.

Users should be able to:

1. Create accounts and professional profiles.
2. Find entrepreneurs in their industries.
3. Join networks and communities.
4. Meet potential business partners and co-founders.
5. Create businesses and startup teams.
6. Raise funds through community crowdfunding.
7. Offer eligible investors documented business ownership.
8. Allow owners and stakeholders to participate in discussions and governance according to their rights.
9. Use CrazyNaters chat and voice communication to collaborate in real time.
10. Build, grow, and participate in businesses together.

The Big Idea: A social network where entrepreneurs meet, build companies, bring communities together, and create opportunities for shared business ownership.

The website should have a modern, professional design that works on desktop and mobile. It should combine a professional social network, startup incubator, crowdfunding platform, and business collaboration community, all connected to the CrazyNaters ecosystem.

Tagline: Connect. Collaborate. Build. Own.

title: Fix Meta Ads Purchase Tracking
description:
I run a D2C supplement brand that has already invested ₹41,000 in Meta Ads across four months. The campaigns generate healthy interest—137 people have added products to cart—but once they hit checkout, they usually stall and never complete payment. UPI, card, and cash-on-delivery options are all visible, yet Meta still records zero purchases.

I need an expert who has solved this exact “Add-to-Cart but no Purchase” puzzle before. Your first task will be to audit every link in the chain: the events fired by the pixel, the campaign objectives, and the landing-page flow. Pinpoint where tracking or conversion friction actually occurs, repair it, and then restructure the account so new campaigns run cleanly and profitably.

Deliverables I expect:
• Clear diagnostic showing why ATCs aren’t converting or being tracked 
• Corrected pixel and event setup, tested end-to-end 
• Revamped campaign structure and creatives ready to scale 
• Ongoing optimisation during the first growth phase

Timing is critical; I’d like to see the audit and first fixes rolled out ASAP. I’m flexible on payment—milestones, commission on verified sales, or another structure we both agree makes sense once purchases start showing up.

When you reply, briefly outline:
1. The most common reasons you’ve seen for ATC without purchase events.
2. What you would inspect first in this case and why.
3. How you plan to confirm the fix is working within the first few days.

If your experience lines up, let’s get conversions flowing.

title: Create AI Training Practice Materials
description:
Description:

I'm building a beginner's training guide for people who want to get into AI training and evaluation work, with a focus on writing and editing roles. I'm looking for someone who has done this kind of work before, for example on Handshake AI, Snorkel AI, Mercor, AfterQuery, DataAnnotation or similar platforms. You'll help me create original practice materials that show beginners what the work involves.

What you'll deliver

-15 original practice exercises in the style of AI training tasks. Examples: rate two chatbot responses side by side and explain your choice, rewrite a weak AI answer, or spot factual and grammar errors in a response.
-A model answer and short scoring notes for each exercise.
-A 1–2 page guide with practical tips: how to approach qualification-style tests, common mistakes beginners make, and how to write clear, well-reasoned feedback.

Important

All materials must be your own original work. Please do not copy or share real tasks, guidelines, test questions or any content covered by a platform's confidentiality agreement.

Who I'm looking for

-Hands-on experience with AI training, data annotation, or response evaluation work
-Excellent written English and editing skills
-Ability to explain your reasoning clearly for a beginner audience

No prior technical experience required for roles that accept beginners

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет получить учебные материалы для новичков в сфере AI-тренинга и оценки ответов ИИ: 15 практических упражнений, эталонные ответы и краткое руководство. Это написание и редактирование контента, а не разработка.

title: AI Startup One-Page WordPress Site
description:
I’m ready to turn our existing copy and domain into a single-page WordPress site that instantly signals innovation and reliability to investors and strategic partners. The aesthetic I have in mind is sleek and futuristic—clean typography, dark-light contrasts, tasteful neon accents, and subtle micro-interactions that feel “AI-powered” without being gimmicky. Every element must scale flawlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop, and the page should stay lightning-fast even with the smooth animations I’d like to showcase.

Primary goal 
The whole experience should guide visitors toward one clear action: submitting an investment or partnership enquiry. I’ll need a form that captures name, company, email, investment interest, and message, then routes each submission to my inbox (and optionally to a CRM if you recommend a lightweight plugin).

Core sections to build 
• Home / Hero 
• About Our Company 
• Vision & Mission 
• AI Services – with AI automation and business process solutions taking center stage 
• Why Choose Us 
• Investor & Strategic Partners 
• Contact / Enquiry

Technical expectations 
• Built on WordPress with a modern page builder or lightweight custom theme—your call, as long as updates remain straightforward. 
• Responsive design tested across major browsers and devices. 
• Optimized images, minified assets, and lazy-loading to keep performance scores high. 
• SEO-friendly structure (semantic headings, meta tags ready for my keywords). 
• Clean, documented code so future iterations are painless.

Timeline & hand-off 
I need the finished, polished site live within 7 days. On completion, please provide: 
1. A fully configured WordPress install on my host 
2. Source files / theme export 
3. Quick walkthrough or loom video explaining how to update content

If you have a portfolio of similarly styled sites—especially tech or SaaS brands—share it so I can move quickly on awarding the project.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен одностраничный сайт на WordPress для AI-стартапа на готовом домене и с существующими текстами. Главная цель — форма заявки для инвесторов и партнёров с отправкой на почту и, возможно, в CRM. Бюджет низкий (1250 INR), срок 7 дней, а объём работ большой.
analysis.reply:
Hi, I read your brief. You want a single-page WordPress site on your existing domain, using your current copy, with a sleek dark/light look, light AI-style micro-interactions, and one main goal: an investor/partner enquiry form that sends submissions to your inbox. I'd build it on a lightweight theme or page builder so future edits stay simple, with optimized images, lazy loading, semantic headings and meta tags for your keywords, and a documented handoff. Using modern tooling and AI-assisted development, I can deliver the core sections within your 7-day window, provided the copy and brand assets are ready from day one. Two quick questions: do you already have WordPress hosting I can access, and which CRM, if any, should receive the leads?

See live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Здравствуйте, я изучил ваше описание. Нужен одностраничный сайт на WordPress на вашем существующем домене с вашими текстами. Визуально — современный стиль с контрастом тёмного и светлого, лёгкие микроанимации в духе AI, а главная цель — форма заявки для инвесторов и партнёров с отправкой на вашу почту. Я бы собрал его на облегчённой теме или конструкторе страниц, чтобы дальнейшие правки были простыми: оптимизированные изображения, ленивая загрузка, семантические заголовки и мета-теги под ваши ключевые слова, а также задокументированная передача проекта. Используя современные инструменты и разработку с помощью ИИ-ассистентов, я могу уложиться в ваши 7 дней, если тексты и брендовые материалы будут готовы с первого дня. Два вопроса: есть ли у вас хостинг WordPress, к которому я могу получить доступ, и в какую CRM, если она нужна, отправлять заявки?

Живые демо: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Mail PDF Letter via USPS
description:
I already have the final one-page PDF ready. Once I send you the file and the full Indian mailing address, I just need you to:

• Print the document on standard letter-size paper.
• Slip it into a plain envelope.
• Ship it from inside the United States using the standard Priority Mail International option. 
 – Please copy the recipient’s address exactly as I provide it. 
 – Leave the return-address space blank.

After you hand the envelope to USPS, send me:

1. The tracking number.
2. A quick photo or scan of the mailing receipt and the addressed envelope.

Person should be from US only, as it has to be sent from there.

No edits, no signatures—simply print, pack, post, and share proof of shipment so I can follow the delivery progress.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет, чтобы в США распечатали готовый однostраничный PDF, вложили в конверт и отправили через USPS Priority Mail International в Индию, с передачей трек-номера и фото чека. Это физическая почтовая работа, а не разработка.

title: Lovable AI Mobile Apps
description:
We are looking for an experienced freelancer/agency specialising in Lovable AI mobile app development.

We have already developed two mobile applications and one web application using Lovable, GitHub and Supabase. All three are integrated into a single project and are currently in the final stage of development.

We are looking for someone to take over the existing applications, complete the final refinements, testing and launch Version 1 on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

We prefer candidates who have successfully developed and launched at least a couple of mobile app projects using Lovable, including publishing and ongoing maintenance.

Please share your relevant experience and live project examples.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет исполнителя, который примет три связанных проекта (два мобильных приложения и веб-приложение на Lovable, GitHub и Supabase), доведёт их до версии V1, протестирует и опубликует в Google Play и App Store. Бюджет низкий, а клиент просит опыт публикации мобильных приложений на Lovable.
analysis.reply:
You have three connected pieces (two mobile apps and a web app built on Lovable, GitHub and Supabase) that need to be taken over, finished, tested and shipped as V1 to Google Play and the App Store. My approach would be to start with an audit of the codebase and Supabase setup: auth, database policies, environment config and anything that blocks a release. Then I'd close the remaining refinements, run a test pass on real devices, and prepare the builds and store listings for both platforms. I work with a modern stack and AI-assisted development, so the pace is fast. A realistic estimate for audit, fixes and submission is about 1–2 weeks, depending on how stable the current builds are. I haven't yet taken a Lovable mobile app through store publication myself, so I want to be upfront about that.

Two questions: which wrapper or framework are the mobile apps currently built with, and do you already have Google Play and Apple developer accounts?

For live demos, see https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
У вас есть три связанных проекта (два мобильных приложения и веб-приложение на Lovable, GitHub и Supabase), которые нужно принять, доделать, протестировать и выпустить в версии V1 в Google Play и App Store. Я бы начал с аудита кодовой базы и настройки Supabase: авторизация, политики доступа к базе, конфигурация окружений и всё, что мешает релизу. Затем закрыл бы оставшиеся доработки, провёл тестирование на реальных устройствах и подготовил сборки и карточки приложений для обеих платформ. Я работаю на современном стеке с помощью ИИ-ассистентов, поэтому темп высокий. Ориентировочный срок на аудит, исправления и отправку на публикацию — около 1–2 недель, в зависимости от стабильности текущих сборок. Я пока не проводил приложение на Lovable через публикацию в сторах самостоятельно, и хочу быть с вами честным об этом.

Два вопроса: на каком обёрточном решении или фреймворке сейчас построены мобильные приложения и есть ли у вас уже аккаунты разработчика Google Play и Apple?

title: Найти 2 клиентов на лендинг за 5 дней
description:
Мы веб-студия Ключ.digital, делаем сайты для малого бизнеса. Нужен человек, который за 5 дней найдёт нам двух клиентов на простой лендинг. 
Что продаёте: 
Лендинг под ключ за 4 000 ₽. В эту цену входит: 
дизайн и вёрстка, сайт работает на телефоне и компьютере 
размещение на нашем сервере 
подключение Яндекс Метрики 
базовая SEO-оптимизация, чтобы сайт находили в поиске 
Чем зацепить клиента: концепт сайта мы делаем бесплатно. Клиент смотрит готовый вариант и платит, только если он ему понравился. Риска для клиента нет. 
Кому предлагать: малый бизнес без своего сайта. Это салоны и мастера красоты, кафе, ремонт, автосервисы, репетиторы, частные специалисты. Таких легко найти в Яндекс Картах. 
Ваша задача: 
Найти бизнесы без сайта. 
Связаться с ними: позвонить или написать в мессенджер. Массовые рассылки не допускаются. 
Предложить бесплатный концепт лендинга. 
Передать нам заявку: название, ниша, имя и телефон контактного лица, что клиенту важно на сайте. 
Концепт, обсуждение деталей и разработку дальше ведём мы. 
Оплата после заказа от клиента 
1000 ₽ за каждого клиента 
за двух клиентов 2000 ₽ 
клиент засчитывается после подтверждённого заказа, то есть когда он одобрил концепт и оплатил сайт 
заявки без оплаты не оплачиваются 
Срок: 5 дней с начала работы. 
Нужен опыт холодных звонков или продаж. В отклике кратко напишите, как будете искать клиентов.

analysis.summary_ru: Студия Ключ.digital ищет исполнителя, который за 5 дней найдёт двух клиентов на лендинг: будет обзванивать и писать малому бизнесу без сайта и получать 1000 ₽ за каждую оплаченную заявку. Это поиск клиентов и холодные продажи, а не разработка.

title: Перенос сайта с Webasyst на 1С-Битрикс (Лайтшоп)

Ищем опытного специалиста (строго не новичка) для запуска проекта под ключ. На текущем этапе нам нужно определиться с исполнителем, понять точный бюджет и сроки, чтобы заложить их в план. 
Задачи, которые нужно оценить (желательно по отдельности): 
1. Установка и базовая настройка 1С-Битрикс и шаблона «Лайтшоп» на хостинг/сервер. 
2. Миграция текущего сайта comfort-center.com. 
3. Перенос каталога товаров, категорий, характеристик и цен (рассмотрим предложенные вами оптимальные способы переноса). 
4. Оценка сроков реализации по каждому этапу. 
Что ждём в отклике: 
1. Примеры ваших реальных проектов на 1С-Битрикс (особенно на готовых решениях). 
2. Предварительную вилку цен и сроков по пунктам 1–3. 
3. Ваш бриф или список уточняющих вопросов (по количеству товаров, модификациям, хостингу и т.д.), которые нужны для точного расчёта. 
Бюджет в объявлении указан условно — ориентируемся на ваши реальные оценки. Готовы оперативно заполнить бриф и обсудить детали.

title: WeWeb + Supabase developer for API connectors and dashboards
description:
We have a web app built on WeWeb and Supabase, and it's half built. We need an experienced developer to help us finish it.

The work:

Connect third-party apps through Nango and MindCloud, and store the data in Supabase.
Build data tables, charts and dashboards in WeWeb that combine data from several sources.

You must have done this kind of work before. We start with a small paid trial, and then pay by milestone. You'll need to sign an NDA before any details or access are shared.
We need an experienced person to join us now and help finish two parts.

1. Connectors
Connect apps to our system through Nango and MindCloud, store the data in Supabase, and keep it syncing daily without errors. You'll follow the setup we already have, so you must have done this kind of work before.

2. Report gallery and dashboards
Customers choose a ready report and see their own data. We need someone who knows how to structure data from different apps so it can be combined. You'll build the data tables, charts and dashboards in WeWeb.

Start your bid with the word "Supabase".

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно доделать веб-приложение на WeWeb и Supabase: подключить сторонние сервисы через Nango и MindCloud с ежедневной синхронизацией в Supabase и построить в WeWeb таблицы, графики и дашборды, которые объединяют данные из нескольких источников. Бюджет 37 500 INR, оплата по этапам после пробного периода, перед доступом нужен NDA.
analysis.reply:
Supabase is the right storage layer here, so I'd start by reviewing the half-built WeWeb project and the current Nango and MindCloud setup. The plan is to finish the connectors so each source writes into normalized Supabase tables on a daily schedule, with error logging and retries so failed syncs don't go unnoticed. Then I'd map fields from each app to a shared schema so the reports can combine data, and build the WeWeb tables, charts and report gallery on top of it. For a first milestone covering one connector and one report, I'd estimate about a week once I have access. Which connectors are already working and which are still missing? And which apps should the first report combine?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Supabase здесь подходящее хранилище, поэтому я бы начал с разбора наполовину готового проекта в WeWeb и текущей настройки Nango и MindCloud. План такой: доделать коннекторы так, чтобы каждый источник ежедневно писал данные в нормализованные таблицы Supabase, с логированием ошибок и повторными попытками, чтобы сбои синхронизации не оставались незамеченными. Затем я сопоставил бы поля из каждого приложения с общей схемой, чтобы отчеты могли объединять данные, и построил бы поверх нее таблицы, графики и галерею отчетов в WeWeb. Для первого этапа, который покрывает один коннектор и один отчет, я оцениваю работу примерно в неделю после получения доступа. Какие коннекторы уже работают, а какие еще нужно подключить? И какие приложения должен объединять первый отчет?

title: Compact Golf Ball Tracking System
description:
During my practice sessions I want to know exactly where each shot lands, so the project centres on building a small, self-contained tracker that fits inside—or securely attaches to—a regulation golf ball and reports its real-time position. The core sensing package is already defined: a miniature GNSS receiver working alongside a 6-axis accelerometer and gyroscope. 

Your task is to engineer the full solution around those components, from hardware selection and PCB layout through embedded firmware and wireless data transmission, then provide a simple way for me to view the landing coordinates seconds after impact. I’m flexible on the display medium; a phone app, smartwatch interface, or even a pocket-sized screen is acceptable as long as it is quick, reliable, and user-friendly on the driving range. 

Acceptance criteria 
• Overall tracker mass keeps the ball within regulation weight tolerance. 
• Positional accuracy: ±1–2 m at typical range distances. 
• Data visible on the chosen display ≤3 s after the ball stops moving. 
• Battery life covers at least one practice bucket (≈70 shots). 

Please highlight previous projects that prove your experience with low-power GNSS, IMU data fusion, and compact wireless designs. Links or brief descriptions of similar work will help me judge fit quickly.

title: Bangun Asisten Suara AI
description:
Saya ingin membangun asisten suara berbasis AI yang mampu melayani pelanggan melalui panggilan telepon masuk maupun keluar, sepenuhnya dalam Bahasa Indonesia. Fokus utamanya adalah otomatisasi percakapan layanan pelanggan—dari menyapa, memahami maksud penelpon, memberikan jawaban, hingga menutup panggilan dengan sopan.

Ruang lingkup yang saya butuhkan:
• Rancangan arsitektur end-to-end yang menggabungkan Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Large Language Model (LLM) untuk Natural Language Understanding & Generation, serta Text-to-Speech (TTS) dengan intonasi natural bahasa Indonesia. 
• Integrasi ke sistem telepon (SIP/PBX atau gateway serupa) agar bot dapat menangani panggilan inbound dan outbound tanpa latensi berarti. 
• Alur dialog dasar untuk skenario layanan pelanggan (mis. cek status pesanan, tanya harga, keluhan umum) beserta fallback handling jika intent tidak dikenali. 
• Dashboard ringan atau endpoint API untuk memonitor percakapan secara real-time dan melakukan update intent. 
• Dokumentasi instalasi, list dependensi, serta panduan deployment di cloud (AWS, GCP, atau layanan setara).

Kriteria keberhasilan: 
– Respons ≤ 2 detik dari akhir ucapan penelpon hingga balasan suara bot. 
– Akurasi pengenalan ucapan > 90 % pada aksen umum bahasa Indonesia. 
– Percakapan minimal 3 skenario utama berjalan lancar tanpa intervensi manusia.

Saya terbuka pada pilihan teknologi—Whisper, Vosk, Coqui TTS, OpenAI GPT-4o, Rasa, LangChain, atau stack serupa—selama memenuhi kriteria di atas. Silakan jelaskan pendekatan, pengalaman relevan, serta perkiraan waktu realisasi.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно построить AI-голосового ассистента на индонезийском языке для входящих и исходящих звонков: пайплайн ASR, LLM и TTS с интеграцией в SIP/PBX, несколько сценариев обслуживания клиентов и дашборд мониторинга. Бюджет 15 USD явно не соответствует объёму работ.
analysis.reply:
Halo, saya memahami kebutuhannya: asisten suara berbahasa Indonesia yang menangani panggilan masuk dan keluar, mulai dari sapaan, memahami maksud penelpon, hingga memberikan jawaban layanan pelanggan. Saya akan merancangnya sebagai pipeline ASR → LLM → TTS dengan integrasi SIP/PBX, dimulai dari satu skenario inti (misalnya cek status pesanan), lalu diperluas ke dua skenario lain beserta fallback. Dashboard monitoring cukup sederhana berbasis endpoint API. Perkiraan MVP untuk satu skenario sekitar 1–2 minggu, sisanya menyesuaikan kompleksitas integrasi telepon dan target latensi.

Sebelum mulai, boleh saya tahu: sistem telepon apa yang digunakan (Asterisk, FreePBX, atau provider SIP tertentu), dan apakah sudah ada API atau data pesanan yang bisa dihubungkan?

Lihat contoh demo saya di https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

Я бы построил его как пайплайн ASR → LLM → TTS с интеграцией SIP/PBX, начав с одного основного сценария (например, проверка статуса заказа), а затем расширил бы его до двух других сценариев и fallback. title: Lead-Focused Real Estate Site
description:
# Build a High-Performance Real Estate Website in Lofty – Local SEO & AI Search Specialist Required

**I'm hiring an experienced local SEO and AI search optimization specialist to build a lead-generating real estate website inside Lofty.**

The most important qualification for this project is proven success getting businesses found in local Google searches and AI-powered search tools, including ChatGPT.

I am NOT looking for someone whose primary skill is website design. I need someone who understands how to structure, optimize, and build a website that attracts local home sellers, buyers, and people searching for local real estate information.

**If you cannot demonstrate actual local SEO results and experience optimizing websites for AI/ChatGPT search, this project is not a fit.**

## PROJECT OBJECTIVE

Build a professional, trustworthy real estate website designed to generate qualified local leads.

The website will target people searching for:
- Real estate agents and services in my market.
- How to sell a home.
- How to buy a home.
- Local neighborhoods and communities.
- Local real estate information and market conditions.
- Related home services and local information.

The strategy is to build visibility in traditional Google search AND emerging AI-powered search platforms.

I want an 11-part framework that supports search rankings, AI visibility, credibility, and lead conversion.

## THE 11-PART WEBSITE FRAMEWORK

1. **Local SEO Architecture:** Build the site around the actual geographic markets and search terms that matter.

2. **Location Pages:** Create and optimize 50 location pages targeting the communities and markets served.

3. **Service Pages:** Develop dedicated pages matching the real estate services offered and the intent behind local searches.

4. **AI Search Optimization:** Structure content to improve discoverability, relevance, and visibility in ChatGPT and other AI-powered search tools.

5. **Keyword Strategy:** Identify valuable local search terms and incorporate them naturally into the website structure and content.

6. **Content Strategy:** Create useful, locally relevant content that answers the questions buyers and sellers are actually asking.

7. **Trust and Authority:** Establish credibility through professional presentation, relevant local expertise, useful information, and strong calls to action.

8. **Lead Conversion:** Incorporate strategically placed lead capture forms, calls to action, and contact opportunities.

9. **Technical SEO:** Address site structure, page speed, indexing, metadata, mobile usability, and technical SEO issues.

10. **Performance Tracking:** Establish measurable tracking for keyword rankings, search performance, website traffic, and lead activity.

11. **Continuous Optimization:** Use Lofty's AI tools and SEO capabilities to improve content, location targeting, and website performance over time.

## LOFTY PLATFORM FEATURES INCLUDED IN THE PROJECT

The website must be built inside Lofty using its available AI website builder and SEO tools.

The project includes:

- One complete, high-converting real estate website.
- Fast, secure hosting.
- Lofty AI website builder implementation.
- 50 automatically created location pages for the markets served.
- Service pages matching the business.
- AI-generated SEO, content, and location strategies.
- Unlimited AI content rewrites.
- Included platform integrations.
- Keyword discovery tools.
- Rank tracking for 35 keywords.
- Search performance dashboard.
- Website analytics.
- Google Search Console integration.
- SEO site audit tools.
- Monthly AI Suite trial.

I expect the freelancer to understand how to use these features effectively, not simply activate them.

## PROJECT STRUCTURE – THREE PHASES

I want this project completed in three clearly defined phases. Each phase has its own deliverables and payment upon successful completion and approval.

**PHASE 1 – STRATEGY & WEBSITE ARCHITECTURE**

Deliverables:
- Review my target markets and real estate services.
- Develop the local SEO and AI search strategy.
- Identify target keywords and search opportunities.
- Establish the website structure and navigation.
- Plan the 50 location pages and service pages.
- Define the lead capture strategy.
- Present the proposed website architecture for approval.

Payment is released upon completion and approval of Phase 1.

**PHASE 2 – WEBSITE BUILD & IMPLEMENTATION**

Deliverables:
- Build the website directly inside Lofty.
- Implement the approved website architecture.
- Configure the AI website builder and available SEO tools.
- Create and optimize the 50 location pages.
- Create and optimize service pages.
- Implement SEO content and AI search optimization.
- Configure lead capture forms and calls to action.
- Implement available integrations.
- Configure Google Search Console and website analytics.
- Test the website on desktop and mobile.

Payment is released upon completion and approval of Phase 2.

**PHASE 3 – SEO VALIDATION, TESTING & HANDOVER**

Deliverables:
- Conduct a complete SEO site audit.
- Verify indexing and technical SEO setup.
- Verify keyword tracking and performance dashboard.
- Test lead capture and contact functionality.
- Review location page and service page optimization.
- Verify analytics and Search Console integration.
- Provide a final website walkthrough.
- Provide documentation explaining how to manage and update the website inside Lofty.

Payment is released upon successful completion and approval of Phase 3.

## WHO SHOULD APPLY

You should have:

- Demonstrable local SEO experience.
- Actual experience improving local Google search visibility.
- Experience with AI search optimization, particularly ChatGPT search.
- Experience developing location-based SEO strategies.
- Experience building websites designed to generate leads.
- Strong understanding of keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO, and content architecture.
- Experience with Lofty is strongly preferred.

**Lofty experience matters, but SEO and AI search expertise matter more.** I am willing to consider an excellent SEO specialist who can demonstrate the ability to learn and work within Lofty's platform.

## APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

I received approximately 400 responses to my previous posting. Very few addressed the actual SEO requirements.

To save everyone's time, I am screening applicants based on relevant experience.

**Start your proposal with the following information:**

1. **Local SEO Results:** Give me one specific example of a business or website you helped rank in local Google searches. Include the business type, location, keywords targeted, and measurable results if available.

2. **AI/ChatGPT Search Experience:** Describe a specific project where you optimized a website or business for discovery through ChatGPT or other AI-powered search tools. What did you do, and what results did you achieve?

3. **Lofty Experience:** Have you personally built or managed websites inside Lofty? If so, describe your experience and provide examples if available.

4. **Your Approach:** Briefly explain how you would approach this project and the 11-part framework.

5. **Your Proposal:** Provide your proposed project price, estimated delivery time, and payment breakdown across the three phases.

Generic or copy-paste proposals will be skipped. I am filtering a high volume of replies and want to hear from specialists who understand the actual work involved.

**Please do not apply if your primary experience is graphic design, generic website building, or basic AI-generated content.**

I am looking for a knowledgeable professional who can build a website that competes for local search visibility, earns trust, and consistently generates qualified real estate leads.

title: Real Estate Marketplace Build
description:
I’m ready to commission the end-to-end development of a real estate marketplace that launches with both property sales and rental listings. The goal is an intuitive, scalable web platform where owners, agents, and prospective buyers or tenants can register, post, search, and transact with confidence.

Key objectives
• One unified catalogue showing homes, apartments, and commercial spaces available for either purchase or lease. 
• Robust search and filtering (location, price, bedrooms, amenities, etc.) and a crisp property‐detail page with media galleries, maps, and contact options. 
• Separate self-service dashboards for listers and for admins so content, users, and analytics remain easy to manage. 
• Secure sign-up/login, role-based permissions, and modern payment or booking integrations implemented with best practices. 
• Clean, responsive front-end (React, Vue, or similar) paired with a solid back-end (Laravel, Node, Django, or comparable framework) and a relational database ready for growth. 
• Documentation and basic test coverage to make future feature iterations straightforward.

My timeline is flexible, so we can prioritize quality architecture over rushing to release. When you respond, please centre your proposal on past work that proves you’ve delivered similar multi-vendor or listing platforms—links, live demos, or code samples speak louder than promises.

Let’s build a marketplace that sets a new standard for real estate discovery and transactions.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет разработать веб-платформу недвижимости с единым каталогом для продажи и аренды, поиском и фильтрами, отдельными кабинетами для владельцев и админов, ролевой моделью доступа и интеграциями бронирования. Бюджет 10 000 USD, сроки гибкие.
analysis.reply:
You want one catalogue for both sales and rentals, with strong search, detailed property pages, separate lister and admin dashboards, and role-based access. I'd start with the data model (properties, listing types, users, roles), then build search and filtering by location, price, bedrooms and amenities, followed by property pages with galleries and maps, and finally the dashboards and rental booking flow. I'd use React on the front end, Laravel or Node on the back end, and PostgreSQL, with tests and documentation for the core flows. Working with AI-assisted development keeps the timeline tight; for the full scope I'd estimate about 8–12 weeks, phased so you can review each stage. Which rental booking flow do you need: viewing appointments or full lease requests? Do you have a preferred map provider such as Google Maps or Mapbox?

You can see live demos of my work here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

Я бы начал с модели данных (объекты, типы объявлений, пользователи, роли), затем сделал поиск и фильтры по локации, цене, количеству спален и удобствам, после них страницы объектов с галереями и картами, и в конце кабинеты и сценарий бронирования аренды. title: Urgent Product Business Plan
description:
I must submit a polished business plan to our partner company no later than 11/29/2026. The plan must follow their specific headings and data table structure, yet still read as a compelling, investor-ready document. My venture is a physical-product business that is already stocked and preparing to launch, so the content must reflect an imminent go-to-market strategy rather than early-stage ideation.

You will receive the company’s formatting guide, my product catalogue, preliminary costings, and rough sales forecasts. These materials need to be refined, expanded, and woven into a cohesive narrative that clearly communicates the opportunity and my own vision.

Deliverables (all required):
• Word or Google Docs business plan (up to 30 pages) formatted exactly per the company’s outline 
• Executive summary, detailed market and competitor analysis, and launch strategy for tangible goods 
• Three-year financial model in Excel covering P&L, cash flow, and break-even, fully cross-checked for consistency 
• Risk assessment plus an implementation timeline aligned with our first production run 
• One-page teaser overview extracted from the main plan 

Acceptance criteria:
1. First full draft to me by 11/27/2026 for comments. 
2. Final, error-free files delivered by 10:00am EST on 11/29/2026. 
3. All numbers reconcile across documents; language is clear, engaging, and free of jargon. 

The primary purpose is to craft my own plan for submission rather than tailoring it for a lender, so tone and depth should reflect that. Please integrate frameworks such as SWOT or Porter’s Five Forces only where they add genuine value.

title: Website Profil Bisnis Sederhana
description:
Saya ingin membangun sebuah website profil bisnis yang menampilkan informasi utama perusahaan—profil singkat, daftar layanan, dan cara menghubungi kami. Karena ini pengalaman pertama saya membuat proyek seperti ini, saya butuh panduan langkah demi langkah sekaligus hasil jadi yang siap dipublikasikan. 

Ruang lingkup yang saya bayangkan: 
• Desain bersih dan responsif agar nyaman di desktop maupun ponsel. 
• Halaman “Tentang Kami” untuk profil bisnis. 
• Halaman “Layanan” yang mudah saya perbarui sendiri. 
• Halaman “Kontak” lengkap dengan formulir dan peta lokasi (Google Maps). 
• CMS populer seperti WordPress atau platform serupa sehingga saya bisa mengelola konten tanpa kode. 
• Integrasi dasar SEO (title, meta, sitemap) supaya mudah ditemukan.

title: Shopify Matrixify Support Specialist Needed
description:
Shopify and Matrixify specialist for ongoing store support

We are an Australian store on Shopify. We need a reliable Shopify specialist for ongoing work, starting with a small paid test task. Our inventory runs in Unleashed through its Shopify integration, so accuracy matters more than speed.

Typical tasks

Bulk product setup and updates using Matrixify (imports, metafields, variants, SKUs, images)
Product recommendations: adding accessories as related or complementary products using Shopify Search & Discovery
Theme editor changes to product pages (no custom code unless agreed first)
Checking orders flow correctly into Unleashed and checking inventory sync with Unleashed 

Required

Proven Shopify experience
Matrixify experience, including metafield imports
Ability to work to the Australian business day for urgent items (overlap of a few hours is fine)
Willingness to work only through Shopify collaborator access

Preferred

Experience with Unleashed, or another inventory system linked to Shopify
Experience with the Shopify app

How we work

We work on a duplicate theme first, and changes go live only after we approve them.
Every job ends with a short written note on what was changed.
We export a backup before any bulk change.
Access is removed when each job ends.

To apply, please answer:

Which Shopify and Matrixify projects have you done that are similar? Please include links.
Have you used Unleashed or a similar inventory system with Shopify?
What is your hourly rate, or your fixed price for a first test task: loading a number metafield to 20 products with Matrixify, with a before-and-after backup?
